src: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Pigeni makofi, enyi mataifa yote, mpigieni Mungu kelele za shangwe!
tgt: (Ogoteera kwa basinto ba Kora) Inwe abanto bonsi, aka chinkobi, moterere Nyasae amatera 'omogooko neriogi rinene!

src: Then the king was exceedingly glad, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of harm was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.
tgt: Omorwoti akaba nomogooko omonene mono, agachiika ng'a Danieli arusigwe ase engoro eria. Ase ayio Danieli akarusigwa aroro na tanyorekanete oarire aande onsi ase omobere oye, ekiagera nigo amosemeretie Nyasae oye.

src: So then, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
tgt: Gaki, oyorarie emuma ase egesasiimero nigo ararie ase ekio, na ase ebinto bionsi ebire igoro yaye.

src: You are the daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and children. You are the sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
tgt: Aye omosubati nigo onga nyoko, oria bwangete omosacha oye, na abana baye; naende nigo onga basubati bamino, abwo bangete abasacha babo, na abana babo. Nyoko nigo arenge Omohiti na iso n’Omoamiori orenge.

src: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
tgt: Aye Omonene, inyora buna obogima bwane bore obweng'e, nigo gwatongete Mwanyabaanto bonsi bakwe igo.

src: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn't know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom
tgt: Omonene bw'omoyega agachia koigwa amaache aria aonchoretwe koba edivai, tamanya aase yarwa, (korende abasomba ababuuchete amaache mbamanyete). Omonene oria bw'omoyega akarangeria omonywomi,

src: Yule mkuu wa meza akayaonja yale maji ambayo yalikuwa yamebadilika kuwa divai. Hakujua divai hiyo ilikotoka ingawa wale watumishi waliochota yale maji wao walifahamu. Basi akamwita bwana arusi kando
tgt: Omonene bw'omoyega agachia koigwa amaache aria aonchoretwe koba edivai, tamanya aase yarwa, (korende abasomba ababuuchete amaache mbamanyete). Omonene oria bw'omoyega akarangeria omonywomi,

src: The king commanded that they take off Jonathan's garments and clothe him in purple, and they did so.
tgt: Ere Alekisanda agachiika Yonathani aaborigwe chianga chiaye na koboyigwa chianga chi'oborwoti chiimonyinga. Ayio agakoreka boigo.

src: Mfalme aliamuru wamvue Yonathani mavazi yake na kumvika nguo ya zambarau, nao wakafanya hivyo.
tgt: Ere Alekisanda agachiika Yonathani aaborigwe chianga chiaye na koboyigwa chianga chi'oborwoti chiimonyinga. Ayio agakoreka boigo.

src: “Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you without money, come, buy, and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost!
tgt: “Naama! Inwe mwensi abamore nerang’o, inchwo monywe amaache! Inwe aba motabwati chitaabu, inchwo mogore endagera morie! Inchuo mogore edivai na amabeere motari goakana chitaabu, gose korua kende.

src: the Arodite clan from Arod, and the Arelite clan from Areli.
tgt: na Abaarodi, abarwete ase Arodi, na Abaareli, abarwete ase Areli.

src: But if in spite of all this you do not obey Me, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,
tgt: “Komoraabe mwanyorire emechando eye yonsi, na mogenderere kwanga konyigwera na koba mamincha yane,

src: You who are far off, hear what I have done; you who are near, acknowledge My might.”
tgt: Inwe abamomenyete aare, igwa aya nakorire; nainwe abamomenyete ang’e ancha na koorokia okobua kwane.

src: Ninyi mlio mbali sana, sikieni lile nililofanya; ninyi mlio karibu, tambueni uweza wangu!
tgt: Inwe abamomenyete aare, igwa aya nakorire; nainwe abamomenyete ang’e ancha na koorokia okobua kwane.

src: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him.
tgt: Nasabire ng’a Nyasae Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Tata Obonene, abae omoika bw’obong’aini na bw’okomaanorerwa, erinde momomanye;

src: The priests entered in, and stood before the altar and the temple; and they wept, and said,
tgt: Abakuani baria bakairana gochia ime ye Hekalu na gotenena bosio bw'egesasiimero bakarera bagoteeba:

src: Makuhani wakaingia, wakasimama mbele ya madhabahu na hekalu; wakalia, wakasema,
tgt: Abakuani baria bakairana gochia ime ye Hekalu na gotenena bosio bw'egesasiimero bakarera bagoteeba:

src: When someone flees to one of these cities, stands at the entrance of the city gate, and states his case before its elders, they are to bring him into the city and give him a place to live among them.
tgt: Omonto oria omoiti, ekero aratamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio goika agende atenene ase egeita ki’omochie oyio, akwane amang’ana aye nabatang’ani b’omochie oria. Barabwo bamosoyie ase omochie bamoe aase akomenya ase egati yabo.

src: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.
tgt: Ekero Abaisraeli babuete ense eria, omoganda obo bwonsi ogasangererekana agwo Silo, na agwo bagatenenia Eema y'Omosangererekano.

src: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
tgt: Ere nigo akoimokereria abanto abaitongo igoro, na abwo bachandegete bakorera, nigo akobabeka ase oborendi obuya.

src: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
tgt: (Ogoteera kw'ogoaka ng'a mbuya mono) Inwe abanto b'ense yonsi, moterere Omonene more nomochengo!

src: Zaburi ya shukrani. Mpigieni Bwana kelele za shangwe, dunia yote.
tgt: (Ogoteera kw'ogoaka ng'a mbuya mono) Inwe abanto b'ense yonsi, moterere Omonene more nomochengo!

src: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don't do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”
tgt: Rora, nimbwate abaiseke baane babere abekungi; tiga mbaabarentere, na mobakorere buna moranche, korende abanto aba iga timobakorera ing'ana rinde rionsi, ekiagera basoire nyomba mwane ime na nigo bare inse y'oborendi bwane.”

src: Tazama, ninao binti wawili ambao kamwe hawajakutana kimwili na mwanaume. Acha niwatoe nje kwenu, nanyi mnaweza kuwafanyia lolote mnalotaka. Lakini msiwafanyie chochote watu hawa, kwa sababu wako kwenye ulinzi chini ya dari langu.”
tgt: Rora, nimbwate abaiseke baane babere abekungi; tiga mbaabarentere, na mobakorere buna moranche, korende abanto aba iga timobakorera ing'ana rinde rionsi, ekiagera basoire nyomba mwane ime na nigo bare inse y'oborendi bwane.”

src: Jesus asked His disciples to have a boat ready for Him so that the crowd would not crush Him.
tgt: Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye bamobekere obwato ang’e ase engencho y’abanto; erio omoganda tomomiga.

src: Kwa sababu ya umati mkubwa wa watu, aliwaambia wanafunzi wake waweke tayari mashua ndogo kwa ajili yake, ili kuwazuia watu kumsonga.
tgt: Yeso agateebia aborokigwa baye bamobekere obwato ang’e ase engencho y’abanto; erio omoganda tomomiga.

src: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—
tgt: Na onye okogoro kwao gokogera okore ebibe, konache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore egesegora, kobua koba n'amagoro abere, na gotugutwa Yeanamu ase omorero o kare na kare

src: Kama mguu wako ukikusababisha kutenda dhambi, ukate. Ni afadhali kwako kuingia katika uzima ukiwa kiwete, kuliko kuwa na miguu miwili lakini ukaingia jehanamu.
tgt: Na onye okogoro kwao gokogera okore ebibe, konache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore egesegora, kobua koba n'amagoro abere, na gotugutwa Yeanamu ase omorero o kare na kare

src: A wise man will be filled with blessing. All those who see him will call him happy.
tgt: Omonto omong'aini natogigwe ase obonge, na bonsi abarabe bakomorora inabamoroke omonyagesio.

src: Mwenye hekima atajazwa baraka, na wote wamwonao watamwita mwenye furaha.
tgt: Omonto omong'aini natogigwe ase obonge, na bonsi abarabe bakomorora inabamoroke omonyagesio.

src: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.
tgt: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri, chinguru chiabo nigo chire buna echi'eng'era. Barabwo mbasirie abanto abare mamincha yabo, babune amauga y'emebere y'ababisa babo, na baabarase ne chinsara chiabo.

src: “Mungu alimleta kutoka Misri; yeye ana nguvu kama nyati. Anayararua mataifa yaliyo adui zake, na kuvunja mifupa yao vipande vipande; huwachoma kwa mishale yake.
tgt: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri, chinguru chiabo nigo chire buna echi'eng'era. Barabwo mbasirie abanto abare mamincha yabo, babune amauga y'emebere y'ababisa babo, na baabarase ne chinsara chiabo.

src: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;
tgt: Yakobo agatirimboka, agaika Misiri; ere agakwera aroro, ere omonyene ne chisokoro chiaito.

src: But now, behold, Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord the king, did not know it.
tgt: Na bono rora, Adonia bweeire oborwoti, na aye omonene one omorwoti, tomanyeti amang’ana ayio.

src: The LORD of Hosts will bless them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt My people, Assyria My handiwork, and Israel My inheritance.”
tgt: ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nabasesenie, ateebe: “Imosesenirie inwe Abamisiri, abamore abanto baane, nainwe Abaasuri, abamore emeremo y’amaboko aane, nainwe Abaisraeli, abamore omwando one.”

src: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
tgt: Ere akabagaambera Abayuda agwo Heburoni ase engaki y'emiaka etan'ebere, na emetienyi etano nomo.

src: The grain offering shall consist of fine flour mixed with oil; offer three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
tgt: Naende morue okoruegwa kw’endagera obosie obonuke bwochoganirie n’amaguta: Amo na kera eeri ensae morue obosie ebimunu bitano na kemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,

src: Now therefore, do not hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man. You know what you ought to do to him to bring his gray head down to Sheol in blood.” David’s Reign and Death (1 Chronicles 29:26–30)
tgt: Ase ayio bono, tobaisa komobara ng’a tari na komocha, ekiagera aye nomonto omong’aini; nomanye aye omonyene eki ogwenerete gokora asare, tomotiga agende aase abakuure ore ne chimbuche, ase engencho y’okomocha kwaye kw’ogoitera amanyinga omoite akwe.” Ogokwa kwa Daudi

src: Lakini sasa, usidhani kwamba hana hatia. Wewe ni mtu wa hekima, utajua la kumtendea. Zishushe mvi zake kaburini kwa damu.”
tgt: Ase ayio bono, tobaisa komobara ng’a tari na komocha, ekiagera aye nomonto omong’aini; nomanye aye omonyene eki ogwenerete gokora asare, tomotiga agende aase abakuure ore ne chimbuche, ase engencho y’okomocha kwaye kw’ogoitera amanyinga omoite akwe.” Ogokwa kwa Daudi

src: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
tgt: Inaki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto tachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y'abange.”

src: Kwa kuwa hata Mwana wa Adamu hakuja ili kutumikiwa, bali kutumika na kuutoa uhai wake uwe fidia kwa ajili ya wengi.”
tgt: Inaki Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto tachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y'abange.”

src: “Bear with me a little longer, and I will show you that there is more to be said on God’s behalf.
tgt: Indemereria ake igo, inche nkworokie amang’ana; nimbwate ring’ana ngokwana ribaga ria Nyasae.

src: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.
tgt: Na abaringoria bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo, bakarenta ebioto igoro ase ense ya Misiri.

src: After him, Nathan rose up to prophesy in the days of David.
tgt: Erio boigo akabwatia Nathani; oyio orenge omobani ase amatuko y'omorwoti Daudi.

src: Baada yake, Nathani aliinuka kutoa unabii katika siku za Daudi.
tgt: Erio boigo akabwatia Nathani; oyio orenge omobani ase amatuko y'omorwoti Daudi.

src: So Anansi did that, and he tied the snake to the stick with his vine to keep him straight. When he was all tied up, Anansi took the snake up to heaven.
tgt: Igo anansi agakora igo nagosiba eng'iti eria nomogoye oria erinde eng'iti eria enyare koramboka kabisa ase egete keria. Ekero akorete gosiba eng'iti eria nemegoye eria, anansi akayebogoria akayeira mbaka igoro onyasae.

src: Anansi alifanya hivyo. Kisha akamfunga yule nyoka kwenye kijiti kile kwa kutumia kamba ili kumnyoosha sawasawa. Baada ya kumfunga huyo nyoka vizuri, alimbeba hadi juu mbinguni.
tgt: Igo anansi agakora igo nagosiba eng'iti eria nomogoye oria erinde eng'iti eria enyare koramboka kabisa ase egete keria. Ekero akorete gosiba eng'iti eria nemegoye eria, anansi akayebogoria akayeira mbaka igoro onyasae.

src: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.
tgt: Nigo ngendererete korimera endiba y’etintira ime, aase tari ase ngotacha n’amagoro. Narimeire ase amaache ase endiba entambe, na emerindo yantubire.

src: He did what was right in the reforming of the people, and took away the abominations of iniquity.
tgt: Yosia nigo araetwe buya buna akoraa abanto erio akarusia obobisa bwonsi obwo bwarenge bwabo bw'obobe.

src: Alifanya yaliyo mema katika kuwarekebisha watu, na akaondoa machukizo ya uovu.
tgt: Yosia nigo araetwe buya buna akoraa abanto erio akarusia obobisa bwonsi obwo bwarenge bwabo bw'obobe.

src: And now you are beautiful in your countenance, and wise in your words. If you will do as you have spoken, your God will be my God, and you will dwell in the palace of King Nebuchadnezzar, and will be renowned through the whole earth.”
tgt: Aye nigo ore omonyakieni naende ogokwana n'obong'aini. Oinse gokora buna kwarire eira, Nyasae oo nabe Nyasae one. Aye nomenye ase enyomba y'oborwoti ya Nebukadinesaro naye nobe omokungu bwesiko ase ense engima.”

src: Na sasa wewe ni mzuri katika uso wako, na mwenye busara katika maneno yako. Ukifanya kama ulivyosema, Mungu wako atakuwa Mungu wangu, nawe utakaa katika jumba la mfalme Nebukadreza, nawe utajulikana duniani kote.
tgt: Aye nigo ore omonyakieni naende ogokwana n'obong'aini. Oinse gokora buna kwarire eira, Nyasae oo nabe Nyasae one. Aye nomenye ase enyomba y'oborwoti ya Nebukadinesaro naye nobe omokungu bwesiko ase ense engima.”

src: Then the people went out and plundered the camp of the Arameans. It was then that a seah of fine flour sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley sold for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD.
tgt: Abanto ba Samaria bakagenda bagasakora egetwori ki’Abasiiria. Ase ayio obosie obonuke bw’engano ebitita bibere bokaoonigwa ase esekeli eyemo, na obw’esairi ebitita bine ase esekeli eyemo, buna Omonene ateebete.

src: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.
tgt: Egetuba keria giaterekereretwe igoro y'emegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere. Chiombe isato chikarigereria gochia sugusu, na isato gochia bosongo, na isato gochia Irianyi, na isato gochia moocha; chinsemo chiabo chia magega chikarigereria gochia gati‐gati inse y'egetuba keria.

src: then understand that it is God who has wronged me and drawn His net around me.
tgt: rirorio momanye ng’a Nyasae orentire amabe aya ase ’nde, na ontegire noboreba bwaye.

src: Wine is as good as life to men, if you drink it in moderation. What life is there to a man who is without wine? It has been created to make men glad.
tgt: Edivai nigo enga obogima oboyia ekero omonto akoyenywa ase ekerengo. Obogima ninki edivai etaiyo? Aro nigo aroisirie agokie abanto.

src: Mvinyo ni mzuri kama uhai kwa wanadamu, ukinywa kwa kiasi. Kuna uhai gani kwa mtu asiye na divai? Imeumbwa ili kuwafurahisha wanadamu.
tgt: Edivai nigo enga obogima oboyia ekero omonto akoyenywa ase ekerengo. Obogima ninki edivai etaiyo? Aro nigo aroisirie agokie abanto.

src: A fool's lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
tgt: Chinkwana chi'omoriri nigo chikorenta eriomana, na omonwa oye nigo okorangeria ogoakwa.

src: You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.
tgt: Ekero kwarentire Abalawi ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Abaisraeli goika babeeke amaboko abo igoro ase emetwe yabo.

src: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
tgt: Omonto omotaka nigo agechire nonya nase abanto bamwabo, korende omonda nigo abwate abasani abange.

src: Maskini huepukwa hata na majirani zao, bali matajiri wana marafiki wengi.
tgt: Omonto omotaka nigo agechire nonya nase abanto bamwabo, korende omonda nigo abwate abasani abange.

src: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.
tgt: korende aonchore chinkoro chiaito gochia asare, tonyare kobwatia chinchera chiaye, na kobwata amachiiko aye na emeroberio yaye echiikire, na onsi aya achiigete chisokoro chiaito.

src: Yeye na aielekeze mioyo yetu kwake, ili tutembee katika njia zake zote na kuzishika amri na maagizo na masharti aliyowapa baba zetu.
tgt: korende aonchore chinkoro chiaito gochia asare, tonyare kobwatia chinchera chiaye, na kobwata amachiiko aye na emeroberio yaye echiikire, na onsi aya achiigete chisokoro chiaito.

src: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
tgt: ekiagera endamwamu ya Mwanyabaanto teri gokora ayare boronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

src: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
tgt: Ekero ekeiga oorokirie ng'a ere nomonyene oboronge, naende nere okomoa oboronge oyo okomwegena Yeso.

src: Alifanya hivyo ili kuonyesha haki yake wakati huu, ili yeye awe mwenye haki na mwenye kumhesabia haki yule anayemwamini Yesu.
tgt: Ekero ekeiga oorokirie ng'a ere nomonyene oboronge, naende nere okomoa oboronge oyo okomwegena Yeso.

src: shall we again break your commandments, and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations? Wouldn't you be angry with us until you had consumed us, so that there would be no remnant, nor any to escape?
tgt: Inee! Ntosarie naende amachiiko ao na tonyuomerane nabaanto aba bagokora okogechia oko? Inee! Igo aye tokoba nendamwamu ase tore na otosirie kegima, erinde abatigari tibanyorekana, gose monto onde atooreke?

src: You show loving kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them. The great, the mighty God, Yahweh of Armies is your name:
tgt: Aye nigo okoorokia obwanchani bwao bwa botambe ase abanto chilifu chinyinge, korende nigo okorua egesusuro ase abana ase engencho y'okomocha kw'abaise. Aye Nyasae ore Omonene bw'echinguru, erieta riao nario Omonene bw'Emeganda.

src: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
tgt: Risankwa riane riaonchokire riamwamire ti, na nigo rikona‐kobutoka, na amauga aane nigo akoyia buna omorero.

src: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His servants said to him, “Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor.”
tgt: Erio Saulo agateebia abasomba baye: “Indigerie omokungu okoboria amang'ana korwa ase emeika y'abanto bakuure, nimochiere, ndigie ogosemigwa korwa asare.” Abasomba baye bakamoiraneria: “Naama! Agwo Eni‐Dori omokungu buna oyio nareo.”

src: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
tgt: Naende nemogwenerete abe omonto omanyete kogambera enyomba yaye omonyene buya, na kworokereria abana baye baigwere ase ogosika gwonsi,

src: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.
tgt: Obogare bwa bosio bwe Hekalu ensemo ya moocha, amo neraaro nigo bwarenge obw'ekerengo ki'amaboko rigana erimo.

src: And the LORD said to Moses, “The man must surely be put to death. The whole congregation is to stone him outside the camp.”
tgt: Eri’Omonene agateebia Musa, “Omonto oyio goika aitwe akwe: asokigwe isiko y’egetwori, erio omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena.”

src: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
tgt: Ere nigo akorua endagera oa ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.

src: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.
tgt: Ase rituko ria gatano, omotienyi o kane, omwaka bw’emerongo etato, ekero inche Ezekieli namenyete ang’e norooche rwa Kebari amo nabooswa bande, igoro ekamaanoka, nkarora amaroro akorwa ase Nyasae.

src: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.'

src: Kwa kuwa Mungu alimfufua kutoka kwa wafu asioze kamwe, alitamka maneno haya: “ ‘Nitakupa wewe baraka takatifu zilizo za hakika nilizomwahidi Daudi.'

src: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!' or, ‘There!' don't believe it.
tgt: Na ekero ekio omonto karabateebie: Rora, Kristo naa are! Gose: Ooria! Timwancha.

src: Wakati huo kama mtu yeyote akiwaambia, ‘Tazama, Kristo huyu hapa!' Au, ‘Kristo yuko kule,' msisadiki.
tgt: Na ekero ekio omonto karabateebie: Rora, Kristo naa are! Gose: Ooria! Timwancha.

src: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
tgt: Naki mobe nebirengererio ebio ebio ime yaino buna ebio biarenge ime ya Kristo Yeso.

src: So Edom has been in revolt from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken Yahweh, the God of his fathers.
tgt: Ase igo Abaedomu bagasaria bakaanga kogamberwa n'Abayuda; naboigo ere goika reero iga. Ase engaki eria abanto b'omochie o Libuna boigo bagasaria, bakaanga kogamberwa na Yehoramu, ekiagera ere atigete Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaye.

src: Abner also spoke to the Benjamites and went to Hebron to tell David all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.
tgt: Abineri agakwana n’abanto b’egesaku gia Benjamini boigo. Erio akageenda Heburoni, agateebia Daudi amang’ana ayio Abaisraeli na Ababenjamini bonsi banchete gokora ase are.

src: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “I am about to die, but God will surely visit you and bring you up from this land to the land He promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
tgt: Yusufu agateebia abamwabo: “Ng’ang’e inde gokwa, korende amaene Nyasae nabanyorere enchera y’okobarusia ase ense eye, abatiirie mogende ase ense eria abarierete eira na gotiana, ng’a nae Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Yakobo.”

src: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.
tgt: Abanto be chiamate echio chi'Abakohati nigo baetwe emechie eyio ikomi, amo namarisio arengeo.

src: For we don't have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
tgt: ekiagera aiga titori nomochie oragenderere, korende nigo tokorigia oria orache gocha.

src: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals. He rose early in the morning, and taking the two stone tablets in his hands, he went up Mount Sinai as the LORD had commanded him.
tgt: Erio Musa akabaacha chibao ibere chi’amagena chire buna chiria chi’eritang’ani, akaimoka mambia chuni, agatiira gochia ase egetunwa gia Sinai, buna Omonene konya amochikiire, obogoretie chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena koboko kwaye.

src: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
tgt: Agasunga egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’obomenyo.

src: A king who judges the poor with fairness— his throne will be established forever.
tgt: Omorwoti okogambera abataka ase oboronge, obogambi bwaye ’mbogeenderere gotenena bokong’u.

src: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
tgt: Aye nigo ogosiria okomoiroka Nyasae, naende gwatanga ogosaba ase obosio bwaye.

src: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
tgt: Nimbae inwe abarisia abaya, abarangokie ase enkoro yane, abarabaragerie bare nobong'ani na okomanya.

src: Kisha nitawapeni wachungaji wanipendezao moyo wangu, ambao watawaongoza kwa maarifa na ufahamu.
tgt: Nimbae inwe abarisia abaya, abarangokie ase enkoro yane, abarabaragerie bare nobong'ani na okomanya.

src: He said to them, “Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.
tgt: Erio akabateebia: “Nase ki mogokora amang'ana buna ayio? Abanto bonsi banteebirie amabe aino mogokora.

src: Hivyo akawaambia, “Kwa nini mmefanya mambo kama haya? Nimesikia kutoka kwa watu wote juu ya haya matendo yenu maovu.
tgt: Erio akabateebia: “Nase ki mogokora amang'ana buna ayio? Abanto bonsi banteebirie amabe aino mogokora.

src: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.
tgt: Agakana, akabora, “Timanyeti, gose tinyigweti eki ogokwana.” Agasoka gesieri; etuoni ekabuga.

src: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
tgt: Erio agateebia Yeso, “Yeso, ong'inyore ekero ogocha ase oborwoti bwao!”

src: Then my enemy will see and will be covered with shame— she who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her; at that time she will be trampled like mud in the streets.
tgt: Erio oria ore omobisa one arore ayio, na obosooku mbomotube oria omboretie, “Ng’ai Omonene, Nyasae oo, are?” Nimorigererie ngoke; ere natiringerwe inse buna esike ere inchera.

src: King Alexander met him, and he gave him his daughter Cleopatra, and celebrated her wedding at Ptolemais with great pomp, as kings do.
tgt: Omorwoti Alekisanda akaumerana nabarabwo, nere Tolemai akamonywomeria Alekisanda omoiseke oye Kileopatura. Enyangi egachengerwa agwo Tolemai ase omogooko kobwatekana nobonene amo nechingeencho chia abarwoti.

src: Mfalme Aleksanda alimlaki, akampa binti yake Kleopatra, na akasherehekea harusi yake huko Tolemai kwa fahari kubwa, kama wafalme wanavyofanya.
tgt: Omorwoti Alekisanda akaumerana nabarabwo, nere Tolemai akamonywomeria Alekisanda omoiseke oye Kileopatura. Enyangi egachengerwa agwo Tolemai ase omogooko kobwatekana nobonene amo nechingeencho chia abarwoti.

src: as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness in the law, faultless.
tgt: Nkaba nomokia bw’ogochanda ekanisa, na ase amang’ana ’oboronge bokonyorekana ase amachiiko tinarenge na komocha.

src: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
tgt: Kong’ia orogendo rwane koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao, totiga obobe bongambere.

src: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.
tgt: Agwo ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano, Omwerwa oria akigite etukia y'omotwe oye ere ekemanyererio ng'a neatananete ase Omonene. Erio aire etukia yaye, ayerute ase omorero oria ore inse y'ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe.

src: Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off; and they will empty his vessels, and break their containers in pieces.
tgt: “Ase ayio, bono amatuko ngocha are, ndatome abaumori baabaumore, erinde ebibekerero ebio bitigare bibe bosa, erio biatwe.

src: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
tgt: Omoerio baminto, onsi ayare ay'ekeene, onsi ayare ay'ogosika, onsi ayare ay'oboronge, onsi ayare ay'oborabu, onsi ayagwenerete gwanchwa, onsi ayagokwanwa buya; koborabeo obuya bonde bwonsi, gose ogotogigwa, aya onsi yarengererie.

src: Does not wisdom call out, and understanding raise her voice?
tgt: Inee! Obong’aini tibori korangeria? Okomanya tikori goaka eriogi rinene?

src: The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.
tgt: Ogoseemia okwo gokagwenera Abisalomu na abagaaka bonsi b'Abaisraeli.

src: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, a day of sacred assembly. You must not do any work; wherever you live, it is a Sabbath to the LORD. Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread (Exodus 12:14–28; Numbers 28:16–25; Deuteronomy 16:1–8)
tgt: Ase amatuko atano na rimo mokore emeremo yaino, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka, rituko ri’omosangererekano bwatananirwe ase ogosasiima. Timobaisa gokora meremo ende yonsi. Erio nerituko ri’Esabato ri’Omonene, aande onsi ase moramenye.

src: “ ‘Kuna siku sita mnazoweza kufanya kazi, lakini siku ya saba ni Sabato ya kupumzika, siku ya kusanyiko takatifu. Hamtafanya kazi yoyote. Popote mnapoishi, ni Sabato kwa Bwana. Pasaka Na Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu (Hesabu 28:16-25)
tgt: Ase amatuko atano na rimo mokore emeremo yaino, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka, rituko ri’omosangererekano bwatananirwe ase ogosasiima. Timobaisa gokora meremo ende yonsi. Erio nerituko ri’Esabato ri’Omonene, aande onsi ase moramenye.

src: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
tgt: Abwo bonsi bageechete Sayoni, taga basookigwe na koiranigwa magega.

src: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
tgt: Erio akabarentera chinyama chinyinge buna orotu, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka chinyinge buna omokenye ore ase enyancha;

src: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.

src: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.

src: Yeye ambaye amekuwa akiiba, asiibe tena, lakini lazima ajishughulishe, afanye kitu kifaacho kwa mikono yake mwenyewe, ili awe na kitu cha kuwagawia wahitaji.
tgt: Omoibi taiba naende; mbuya akore emeremo ase omokia namaboko aye na gokora ayare amaya, erinde abe negento akomwatanera oyoremeire.

src: Every male among the priests shall eat of it. It is most holy.

src: How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
tgt: Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere kwebisete? Inee! Ngoika ririri endamwamu yao eragenderere gwoka buna omorero?

src: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.
tgt: Abande ase omosangererekano bagatebereria Alekisanda, oyo Abayahudi bakamosukia ase amaiso 'abaanto. Alekisanda akaimokia okoboko kwaye, akarigia gwekengera.

src: These were the descendants of Ehud who were the heads of the families living in Geba and were exiled to Manahath:
tgt: Abana abamura b’Ehudi nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, echio chiamenyete Geba. Barabwo bagooswa, bakairwa ase ense ya Manahati.

src: And you are to strike down the house of your master Ahab, so that I may avenge the blood of My servants the prophets and the blood of all the servants of the LORD shed by the hand of Jezebel.
tgt: Naye oraite osirie abanto b’enyomba y’Ahabu, omonene oo, erinde inche nyeruserie egesiomba ase Yesebeli, ekiagera ere aiterete amanyinga ’abasomba baane ababani, na ay’abasomba baane bonsi, inche Omonene.

src: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.
tgt: Na abanto b'omochie, na abagaaka, na abanene b'omochie oyio, bagakora buna Yesebeli abateebeetie. Buna koreng'ana ariikire ase amarube aria atomete ase bare,

src: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
tgt: Inche inde omoke kobua abachenu bonsi; nonya nabo ’nkaegwa obuya bw’okoranderia abanto b’Ebisaku obonda bwa Kristo, obo botari korengeka.

src: but Hannah did not go. “After the boy is weaned,” she said to her husband, “I will take him to appear before the LORD and to stay there permanently.”
tgt: Korende ase engaki eyio Ana tagendeteo, agateebia omosacha oye, “Ninganye goika ’ntache omwana, erio nario ndamoire imoorokie ase obosio bw’Omonene, erinde imotige amenye aroro botaambe.”

src: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.

src: Kisha kutoka kwenye kikapu cha mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu, kilichokuwa mbele za Bwana, akachukua andazi moja, na jingine lililotengenezwa kwa mafuta, na mkate mwembamba; akaviweka hivi vyote juu ya mafungu ya mafuta ya mnyama, na juu ya lile paja la kulia.
tgt: Akabeeka ebinto ebio bionsi ase amaboko Aroni, na ay'abamura baye, akabisungusia bibe ekeng'wanso ki'ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw'Omonene.

src: You didn't choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
tgt: Tari inwe mwanchorire inche, korende ninche nabachorire inwe, nababekire mogende kwama, okwama kwaino goikaranse; erio rinde rionsi mogosaba Tata ase erieta riane, nigo arabae.

src: Si ninyi mlionichagua, bali mimi ndiye niliyewachagua ninyi na kuwaweka mwende mkazae matunda, na matunda yenu yapate kudumu. Ili nalo lolote mtakalomwomba Baba katika Jina langu, awape ninyi.

src: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
tgt: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, Sodomu, mosubati omino, na abaiseke baye, tibarakora buna aye gwakorire amo nabaiseke bao.

src: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.

src: Iwapo sadaka yako ya nafaka imeandaliwa kwenye kikaango, itakuwa ni ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta, bila chachu.

src: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
tgt: Omonene bwechooreire Yakobo, bwechooreire Abaisraeli koba aba aye bori.

src: For those who have kept the things that are holy in holiness will be made holy. Those who have been taught them will find what to say in defense.
tgt: Baria batenererete amang'ana y'obochenu mbancherwe koba abachenu. Boigo na baria begerigwe ayio mbanyore enchera yokwerwanerera engaki y'ekina.

src: Kwa maana wale walioyatunza mambo yaliyo matakatifu katika utakatifu watatakaswa. Wale waliofundishwa watapata la kusema katika kujitetea.
tgt: Baria batenererete amang'ana y'obochenu mbancherwe koba abachenu. Boigo na baria begerigwe ayio mbanyore enchera yokwerwanerera engaki y'ekina.

src: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.
tgt: “Omonto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, oraite eng'iti y'orosana, gose enyoni eyancheire koriegwa, goika aitere amanyinga aye inse, erio ayatube amaroba.

src: Yahweh says, “Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.
tgt: Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Onye moganetie gotooria obogima bwaino, mwerende, timobaisa kobogoria egurube ende yonsi ase rituko ri'Esabato, gose koyesoyia ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu ase rituko erio.

src: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.
tgt: Eta, eta, mosoere ase ebiita, moroiserie abanto enchera; ticha enchera eyio eimokerere igoro, rusia amagena korwa aroro; tenenia ekemanyererio abanto bakerore.

src: The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent's food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says Yahweh.
tgt: Esese y'orosana na emaanwa y'eng'ondi nchibe chikoriseria amo, endo nebe ekorisia obonyansi buna eng'ombe, na orotu ndobe endagera y'eng'iti engenda inse. Ogokora bobe na ogosiria konde gwonsi tikogokorwa ase egetunwa kiane egechenu. Nab'Omonene atebiire.”

src: In the Most Holy Place he made two cherubim of sculptured work, and he overlaid them with gold.
tgt: Ime y’Aase Achenu Mono akaroisia emegwekano ebere y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, akayeooma ne chitaabu.

src: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
tgt: Hiramu agatoma abanto baye baria bamanyete emeremo ye chinyancha, bagasang'ana nabaanto ba Sulemani.

src: “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.” Jesus Anointed at Bethany (Mark 14:3–9; Luke 7:36–50; John 12:1–8)

src: Lakini wakasema, “Isiwe wakati wa Sikukuu, kusitokee ghasia miongoni mwa watu.” Yesu Anapakwa Mafuta Huko Bethania (Marko 14:3-9; Yohana 12:1-8)
tgt: Korende bakaboora, “Taba ase rituko rinene, tiribaisa goocha koba rirorooche ase abanto.” Yeso ogoakwa amaguta agwo Bethania (Mar 14:3-9; Yoh 12:1-8)

src: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I have given this land—from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates—
tgt: Ase rituko eri’Omonene agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’Aburamu, agateeba: “Ororeeria rwao naroire ense eye gochakera ase orooche orwo oronene rokorokwa Eufarati,

src: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.
tgt: Abagaaka tibari goikaransa geita ki'omochie, na abamura batigire kobugia amakano abo.

src: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
tgt: Abanto abamwenu batabwateti amachiiko ao nigo bankuunyeire emetaro.

src: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband's authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”

src: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that Yahweh's hand has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.

src: ili kwamba watu wapate kuona na kujua, wapate kufikiri na kuelewa, kwamba mkono wa Bwana umetenda hili, kwamba yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli ndiye alilifanya.”
tgt: ende egwekaine emeuru, na emebeno amo, erinde abanto mbarore na komanya, naende mbaarengererie bamanye bonsi amo, ng'a nokoboko kw'Omonene gwakorire ayio, ee, ere oyore Omochenu bw'Abaisraeli nere otongete ebio bionsi.”

src: “The first was like a lion, and had eagle's wings. I watched until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth and made to stand on two feet as a man. A man's heart was given to it.
tgt: Eng'iti entang'ani nigo yagwekaine endo, korende yabwate chimbaaba buna echi'ekeongo. Buna nabeete ndigereretie, chimbaaba chiaye nigo chiasimoire, ero ekaimokererigwa igoro korwa ase riroba, egatenenigwa namagoro abere buna omonto, ekaegwa enkoro ya Mwanyabaanto.

src: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?

src: to whom He has said: “This is the place of rest, let the weary rest; this is the place of repose.” But they would not listen.

src: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself; and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”

src: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”

src: “Yule tajiri akasema, ‘Hapana, baba Abrahamu, lakini mtu kutoka kwa wafu akiwaendea, watatubu.'
tgt: Akabora: Yaya, tata Aburaamu, korende oyomo korwa ase abakuure aise kobachiera, inabaonchoke.

src: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
tgt: Kwandasire emegwe yao yasoeire ime yane, kwanyiyeirie inse nokoboko kwao.

src: Then the word of the LORD came to Samuel, saying,
tgt: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigaacha ase Samweli, rikamoteebia,

src: Then Moses led Israel from the Red Sea, and they went out into the Desert of Shur. For three days they walked in the desert without finding water.
tgt: Erio Musa agatang’ana Abaisraeli kogenda orogendo korwa ase Enyancha Embariri gochia erooro ya Suri. Bagataara ase engaki y’amatuko atato ase erooro, na tibanyora maache.

src: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.
tgt: Ase igo, ase ebinto bibere bitanyare koonchorwa, ime ase ebio Nyasae takonyara gokwana oborimo, intwe, abatwatameire obotamero, tonyore okoremigwa ogokong'u kobwata ogosemeria koria kwabekirwe bosio bwaito.

src: Mungu alifanya hivyo ili kwa vitu viwili visivyobadilika, yaani ahadi yake na kiapo chake, ambavyo kwavyo Mungu hawezi kusema uongo, sisi ambao tumemkimbilia ili tulishike lile tumaini lililowekwa mbele yetu tuwe na faraja thabiti.
tgt: Ase igo, ase ebinto bibere bitanyare koonchorwa, ime ase ebio Nyasae takonyara gokwana oborimo, intwe, abatwatameire obotamero, tonyore okoremigwa ogokong'u kobwata ogosemeria koria kwabekirwe bosio bwaito.

src: For some have already turned aside to follow Satan.
tgt: Inaki abaande bairanire magega, na gotunyana Saitani.

src: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
tgt: Nigo bore omote bw'obogima ase abwo babobwatererete; na kera omonto ogendererete kobobwata bokong'u nasesenirie.

src: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
tgt: Inaki ase egati yabo mbareo abagwesoyia ase chinyomba chi'abaanto gosakora abakungu aboro, abare ne chigurube chi'ebibe, na koraagwa nokogania okobe gwe chingeencho ao ao.

src: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
tgt: Nomonto oria obwate amaboko atari na komocha, na enkoro echenegete, noria otari gosasiima chinyasae chi’oborimo, gose gotiana ase obong’ainereria.

src: But they seized the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
tgt: Abaremi baria bakabwata omosomba oria, bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.

src: Lakini wale wakulima walimkamata yule mtumishi, wakampiga, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.
tgt: Abaremi baria bakabwata omosomba oria, bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.

src: O LORD God of Hosts, how long will Your anger smolder against the prayers of Your people?
tgt: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ngoika ririri orabe gokogechigwa nogosaba kw’abaanto bao?

src: For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
tgt: Inche ninche Omonene, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri imbe Nyasae oino. Ase ayio, mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche nomochenu inde.”

src: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died,
tgt: Korende Yusufu, na bamura bamwabo bonsi, na abanto bonsi b’ekegori keria bagakwera Misiri.

src: If only this people were under my authority, I would remove Abimelech; I would say to him, ‘Muster your army and come out!’” The Fall of Shechem
tgt: Onye abanto aba ’nkoba barenge ase oborendi bwane, anga ’narusia Abimeleki. Nigo nare komoteebia: Menta abarwani bao b’esegi, erio ochiche korwana!”

src: Laiti watu hawa wangekuwa chini ya amri yangu! Basi mimi ningemwondoa huyo Abimeleki. Ningemwambia Abimeleki, ‘Ondoa jeshi lako lote.’ ”
tgt: Onye abanto aba ’nkoba barenge ase oborendi bwane, anga ’narusia Abimeleki. Nigo nare komoteebia: Menta abarwani bao b’esegi, erio ochiche korwana!”

src: Hadad and his men set out from Midian and went to Paran. They took men from Paran with them and went to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave Hadad a house and land and provided him with food.
tgt: Bakarua Midiani, bakagenda bagaika Parani, naende bakagenda amo nabaanto bande korwa Parani, bagaika Misiri. Aroro bakagenda ase Farao, omorwoti o Misiri. Ere akamoa enyomba, naende akamochikera endagera arenge koba okonyora botambe; boigo akamoa oboremo.

src: Wakaondoka Midiani wakaenda Parani. Basi wakichukua pamoja nao wanaume kutoka Parani, wakaenda Misri, kwa Farao mfalme wa Misri, ambaye alimpa Hadadi nyumba, ardhi na akampatia chakula.
tgt: Bakarua Midiani, bakagenda bagaika Parani, naende bakagenda amo nabaanto bande korwa Parani, bagaika Misiri. Aroro bakagenda ase Farao, omorwoti o Misiri. Ere akamoa enyomba, naende akamochikera endagera arenge koba okonyora botambe; boigo akamoa oboremo.

src: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
tgt: Nonya omonto oyio ekero are moyo, ogweteba ng'a nigo asesenirie, ee, nonya ogotogigwa ekero ekoreire amaya,

src: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
tgt: Ebisabo biabo mbirande, na obwari bwabo nabobe buna obw'emezeituni, ne rimisu riabo ndiesiarere buna eri'emete ya Lebanoni.

src: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
tgt: Ere, ekero achia goika na korora buna obuya bwa Nyasae bwakorire, akagoka, agasorora bonsi babe abegenwa ase Omonene ase okogania gwe chinkoro.

src: I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
tgt: Aye Omonene, goika kare na kare ninterere obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, nindarie obwegenwa bwao ase ebiaare bionsi.

src: Nitaimba juu ya upendo mkuu wa Bwana milele; kwa kinywa changu nitajulisha uaminifu wako ujulikane kwa vizazi vyote.
tgt: Aye Omonene, goika kare na kare ninterere obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, nindarie obwegenwa bwao ase ebiaare bionsi.

src: when you disobey the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then Yahweh's anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”
tgt: Onye mogosaria okobwatana kw'Omonene, Nyasae oino, okwo abachigete, naende mogokorera chinyasae chinde na gochisasiima, erio endamwamu yaye inayoke igoro yaino, nainwe bwango mosire korwa ase ense eye engiya abaeire.”

src: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”
tgt: Balaki agateebia Baalamu, “Bono inchwo 'nkoire aase ande aao. Aande gose Nyasae nanche obandagererie korwa aroro.”

src: You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.
tgt: na ekero mwasiboretwe korwa ase ebibe mogakorwa koba abasomba b’oboronge.

src: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,
tgt: Omonene abakore momenteke na gokiina ase ogwanchana inwe ase inwe, na ase ogwancha abanto bonsi, buna intwe tobanchete inwe.

src: Bwana na auongeze upendo wenu na kuuzidisha kati yenu na kwa wengine wote, kama vile tulivyo na upendo mwingi kwenu.
tgt: Omonene abakore momenteke na gokiina ase ogwanchana inwe ase inwe, na ase ogwancha abanto bonsi, buna intwe tobanchete inwe.

src: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and it cast down some of the army and of the stars to the ground and trampled on them.
tgt: Orogunchara orwo rogakiina mono, rogaika ase emeganda ya igoro, rokaiyeria emeganda ende ne ching'enang'eni gocha inse aa, rogachitiringerao.

src: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?
tgt: Ere oyio ogosanga nabanyabibe na gotaara nabakori amabe.

src: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
tgt: Agachora Daudi omosomba oye, akamorusia korwa ase arenge korisia ching'ondi.

src: Akamchagua Daudi mtumishi wake na kumtoa kwenye mazizi ya kondoo.
tgt: Agachora Daudi omosomba oye, akamorusia korwa ase arenge korisia ching'ondi.

src: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!
tgt: Gakwanire aya, akabautera omoika, akabateebia, “Nyora Omoika Omochenu.

src: and Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told about it, he went down to the rock and stayed in the Wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard of this, he pursued David there.
tgt: Saulo na’baanto baye bakagenda korigia Daudi, korende Daudi agateebigwa amang’ana ayio. Ase ayio akagenda ase egetare kiareenge ase erooro ya Maoni, akabeerao. Ekero Saulo aigwete ng’a Daudi ogendire agwo akamobwatia gochiao.

src: But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.
tgt: Korende baminto, timorosa gokora amaya.

src: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.
tgt: Yeso nigo arenge Bethania ase enyomba ya Simioni oyorenge noborwaire bwa ukoma. Ekero Yeso aikaransire ase endagera, omokungu agacha orenge nechuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta agotioka buya, aye rigori rinene, agaata echuba eria, akamonyororokeria omotwe oye.

src: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.
tgt: agachoora ng’a mbuya konyora emechando amo nabaanto ba Nyasae kobua kwegokia ase ebibe ase ekero egeke.

src: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
tgt: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano nemo, na magana abere (6,200).

src: saying, “Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD!” So he had him ride in his chariot.
tgt: Akamoteebia: “Inchuo amo nainche, orore risemi riane na omokia one ase Omonene!” Erio bakagenda komo ase egari ya Yehu.

src: Yehu akasema, “Twende pamoja ukaone wivu wangu kwa ajili ya Bwana.” Hivyo wakasafiri pamoja kwenye gari lake.
tgt: Akamoteebia: “Inchuo amo nainche, orore risemi riane na omokia one ase Omonene!” Erio bakagenda komo ase egari ya Yehu.

src: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
tgt: Lea akabora: “Inche ninde nomogooko omonene, naki abakungu nabandoke Oyore n'omogooko.” Ase igo, akamoroka Aseri.

src: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.
tgt: Magega kobamenyire agwo ase engaki etai 'nke, bakaegwa ribaga nabaminto bagende nomorembe ase baria baabatomete.

src: Baada ya kukaa huko Antiokia kwa muda, wakaagwa kwa amani na wale ndugu ili waende kwa wale waliowatuma.
tgt: Magega kobamenyire agwo ase engaki etai 'nke, bakaegwa ribaga nabaminto bagende nomorembe ase baria baabatomete.

src: For when they heard that through their own punishments the others benefited, they recognized the Lord.
tgt: Ekero baigwete buna egesusuro kiao nigo giakonyete abanto bao, bagateeba buna aye Omonene naye gwakorete ayio onsi.

src: Kwa maana waliposikia kwamba kupitia adhabu zao wenyewe wengine walifaidika, walimtambua Bwana.
tgt: Ekero baigwete buna egesusuro kiao nigo giakonyete abanto bao, bagateeba buna aye Omonene naye gwakorete ayio onsi.

src: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold, in addition to the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and in addition to the chains that were about their camels' necks.
tgt: Oborito bw'e'bigera biria asabeete aegwe nigo bwarenge koreng'ana chikiiro emerongo ebere. Amo n'ebio akaira chisonoi, n'ebigera, ne chianga chimonyinga, ebinto abarwoti b'Abamidiani barenge kobeeka, amo ne chisonoi chiria chiarenge ase amagoti ye'chingamia chiabo.

src: Then I wouldn't be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
tgt: Rirorio tingosookigwa ekero 'ndabe 'ndigereretie amachiiko ao onsi.

src: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of Yahweh with you; but if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?”
tgt: Gaki onkorere inche, omosomba oo, amaya, ekiagera gwakorire okobwatana kw'ogotianania amo nainche ase obosio bw'Omonene. Korende onye okomocha kore ase 'nde, rirorio aye omonyene ong'ite. Nase ki okong'ira ase iso, erinde ere ang'ite?”

src: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down to make a defense against the mounds and against the sword:
tgt: Naende aya naro inche Omonene bw'Abaisraeli ngoteeba igoro ye chinyomba chi'omochie oyo, na igoro ye chinyomba chi'abarwoti b'Abayuda, chiria chiatagoretwe nabwo baagachete chindwaki chi'ogwekengera, naende bakorwana esegi:

src: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.
tgt: Amang'ana ao abeire akoremia oyo konya osinyirwe kogenderera, na aye gwakong'irie amaru aye arenge koiguswa.

src: But David said to Michal, “I was dancing before the LORD, who chose me over your father and all his house when He appointed me ruler over the LORD’s people Israel. I will celebrate before the LORD,
tgt: Daudi akairaneria Mikali, “Nigo narenge gotenga na kogooka ase obosio bw’Omonene, oyo onchorete inche ribaga ria iso, na enyomba yaye yonsi, ’nkaba omogambi bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye. Ase ayio, goika ’ngenderere gochenga ase Omonene.

src: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don't wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”
tgt: Imokia ekemanyererio kiorokie enchera egochia Sayoni; tama motooreke, timobaisa goteebana, ekiagera nkorenta nde obobe na ogosaria okonene korwa sugusu.”

src: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.
tgt: Naende emeganda yonsi, abasangererekanete korora aya, kobachia korora ayakoreka, bakairana chinka chiabo, bakweaka ebikuba.

src: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to Yahweh.
tgt: Ase ayio Abaisraeli bagakorwa koba abataka mono ase engencho y'Abamidiani; erio bakarera ase Omonene ng'a abakoonye.

src: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
tgt: Inee! Omonto gakuure, nairane koba moyo naende? Inche ase amatuko aane onsi inchikeire, nimbe nganyete, goika ogosiborwa kwane goche.

src: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
tgt: Lawi nigo abwate abamura batato: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.

src: Haya yalikuwa majina ya wana wa Lawi: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.
tgt: Lawi nigo abwate abamura batato: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.

src: The Commander of the LORD’s army replied, “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.” And Joshua did so.
tgt: Omotang’ani oria bw’omoganda okorwana esegi y’Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Rusia ebikoroto biao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine naachenu.” Na Yoshua agakora bo.

src: Then I said of her who had grown old in adulteries: ‘Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is!’
tgt: Erio nkeboria: Inee! Abanto aba abanyaka nigo bagochia gokora obonyaka nomokuungu oyo okorire obonyaka ase engaki entambe?

src: Ndipo nikasema kuhusu yule aliyechakazwa na uzinzi, ‘Basi wamtumie kama kahaba, kwa kuwa ndivyo alivyo.’
tgt: Erio nkeboria: Inee! Abanto aba abanyaka nigo bagochia gokora obonyaka nomokuungu oyo okorire obonyaka ase engaki entambe?

src: Day after day, from the first day to the last, Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God. The Israelites kept the feast for seven days, and on the eighth day they held an assembly, according to the ordinance.
tgt: Kera rituko, korwa erie ritang’ani goikera eri’omoerio, Ezra akaba okobasomera Korea ase Egetabu keria kiarikire amachiiko a Nyasae. Abanto bakagenderera korenda Amatuko aria Amanene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, na ase rituko ria gatano na gatato bakaba nomosangererekano omonene bw’ogosasiima, buna yachikiire.

src: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.'”
tgt: Eri'Omonene agateebia Musa, “Moteebie Aroni abwate enyimbo yaye, ayeimokie igoro ye chindooche, na ebirooche, na amatibo, erinde agere ebioto bigende igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”

src: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Mwambie Aroni, ‘Nyoosha mkono wako ukiwa na ile fimbo yako juu ya vijito, mifereji na madimbwi, fanya vyura waje juu ya nchi ya Misri.' ”
tgt: Eri'Omonene agateebia Musa, “Moteebie Aroni abwate enyimbo yaye, ayeimokie igoro ye chindooche, na ebirooche, na amatibo, erinde agere ebioto bigende igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”

src: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
tgt: nario aroche obong'aini naende akaboraria; akaboikerania na koboenekia ase abanto.

src: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.
tgt: Ekero omonto onde bwensi akorua ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe ase 'nde, ase engencho y'eira ariete, gose eki'ogwancha kwaye, korwa ase chiombe gose ching'ondi, goika ebe eng'iti eng'ikeranu, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, eyio nero erancherwe.

src: Mtu yeyote aletapo sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana kutoka kundi la ngʼombe au mbuzi ili kutimiza nadhiri maalum au sadaka ya hiari, lazima sadaka hiyo isiwe na dosari au waa ili ikubalike.
tgt: Ekero omonto onde bwensi akorua ekeng'wanso ki'omorembe ase 'nde, ase engencho y'eira ariete, gose eki'ogwancha kwaye, korwa ase chiombe gose ching'ondi, goika ebe eng'iti eng'ikeranu, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, eyio nero erancherwe.

src: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds. until it comes near, he will not be comforted. He won't depart until the Most High visits and he judges righteously and executes judgment.
tgt: Ere tari gosiereria amasabo yechintakana, gose amasabo yomoboraka ekero akomotebia omogano oye.

src: Sala ya mnyenyekevu hupenya mawingu; hata ikakaribia, hatafarijika. Hataondoka mpaka Aliye Juu ajitokeze, naye ahukumu kwa haki na kutekeleza hukumu.
tgt: Ere tari gosiereria amasabo yechintakana, gose amasabo yomoboraka ekero akomotebia omogano oye.

src: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
tgt: Abana abamura b'Elionai nabwo aba: Hodawia na Eliasibu, Pelaya na Akubu, Yohanani na Delaya, na Anani; bonsi mbatano na babere (7).

src: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
tgt: Aya naro amarieta ’abana baiboretwe asare agwo Yerusalemu: Samua na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani,

src: If a man makes a vow to the LORD or swears an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word; he must do everything he has promised.
tgt: Ekero omonto akoria eira ase Omonene, gose agotiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete, tagosaria eira eria yaye. Goika akore na goikerania buna akwanete.

src: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.'”
tgt: Inyora abasomba bao Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Israeli, na buna kwabarierete eira ase ogwetiania, okabateebia: Nigo ndamente oroiboro rwaino robe oronge buna ching'enang'eni chia igoro. Nimbae ense eye yonsi nabarierete eira ng'a nimbae ebe omwando obo kare na kare.”

src: Wakumbuke watumishi wako Abrahamu, Isaki na Israeli, ambao uliwaapia kwa nafsi yako mwenyewe: ‘Nitawafanya uzao wako kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani, nami nitawapa wazao wako nchi hii yote ambayo niliwaahidia, nayo itakuwa urithi wao milele.' ”
tgt: Inyora abasomba bao Aburaamu, na Isaka, na Israeli, na buna kwabarierete eira ase ogwetiania, okabateebia: Nigo ndamente oroiboro rwaino robe oronge buna ching'enang'eni chia igoro. Nimbae ense eye yonsi nabarierete eira ng'a nimbae ebe omwando obo kare na kare.”

src: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.
tgt: Na abasacha boigo bagatiga okomenyana nabakungu kwa boronge, bagasambwa ase okorigania abasacha ase abasacha, bagakora ogokora kw'obosooku, bakanyora abanyene ogoakanwa kwa boronge kw'ogosaria kwabo.

src: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
tgt: Omonto ogokwana amang'ana amaange tari komocha korenta ogosaria, korende oyo orendete omonwa oye nigo are omong'aini.

src: For being ignorant of God's righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn't subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
tgt: Inaki kobar'abe tibamanyeti oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae, naende bakorigia goikerania oboronge bwabo abanyene, igo tibebegeti inse ase oboronge bwa Nyasae.

src: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
tgt: ne chinyoni chikoiruruka amo ne chinswe chi’enyancha, na kende gionsi kegoetanana ase chindiba chie chinyancha.

src: ndege wa angani na samaki wa baharini, naam, kila kiogeleacho katika njia za bahari.
