tgt: Abaminto, bara ng’a nomogooko bwoka komorasoe ase amateemwa are ao ao,

src: yet I and my sons and my kindred will walk in the covenant of our fathers.
tgt: inche na abana baane amo na bamura baminto nigo toragenderere gotunyana okobwatana ogochenu intwe twakorete n'Omonene oito.

src: lakini mimi na wanangu na jamaa zangu tutatembea katika agano la baba zetu.
tgt: inche na abana baane amo na bamura baminto nigo toragenderere gotunyana okobwatana ogochenu intwe twakorete n'Omonene oito.

src: The world can't hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
tgt: Ense tekonyara kobagecha inwe, korende nigo engechete inche, ekiagera inche nkoyeorokia ng'a emeremo yaye nemebe.

src: He who watches the wind will fail to sow, and he who observes the clouds will fail to reap.
tgt: Omonto okona‐korigereria komanya igoro y’embeo tagosimeka, na oyo okona‐korigereria amare buna are takogesa.

src: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather the wheat into His barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
tgt: Oroteru rwaye nigo rore koboko kwaye, ere naabuse ekeooreri kiaye, nasangererie engano ase ekiage kiaye, korende omoiriro nayosambe ase omorero otakorimeka.”

src: Then he must bring to the priest his guilt offering to the LORD: an unblemished ram of proper value from the flock.
tgt: Erio andeetere inche Omonene emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye; ayerusie korwa ase riicho riaye rie ching’ondi, ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye; naye oyekorere rigori, na omonto oria ayeirere Omokuani.

src: The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Don't abandon your servants! Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us; for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us.”
tgt: Erio Abagibeoni bagatoma abanto ase Yoshua agwo Giligali ase atoorete komoteebia, “Tototiga intwe abasomba bao! Ayerera, otiire gocha aa, otokonye na gototooria, ekiagera abarwoti bonsi b'Abaamori, abwo bamenyete ase ense y'ebitunwa, basangererekanire gotorwania.”

src: Machir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. The name of his sister was Maacah. Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
tgt: Makiri akanywomeria Hupimu omokungu, boigo akanywomeria Supimu omokungu. Omoiseke omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Maaka. Omwana omomura o kabere o Manase nigo arenge korokwa Selofehadi. Selofehadi nigo abwate abana abaiseke boka.

src: and the villages on her mainland will be slain by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’
tgt: Abanto b’emechie yaye emeke ere ase engegu mbakenywe nemioro. Erio nario baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.

src: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
tgt: Abatigari, abwo bare b'ororeeria rwa Yakobo, mbamoiranere Nyasae Omobui.

src: Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a man can commit is outside his body, but he who sins sexually sins against his own body.
tgt: Tama obotomani! Kera ebibe binde bigokorwa na Mwanyabaanto nigo bire isiko y’omobere; korende ere oyogokora obotomani igo okorire ebibe ase omobere oye omonyene.

src: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.
tgt: Na onde tarenge igoro, gose ase ense, gose inse y'ense oyogwenerete koigora egetabu, gose koyerigereria.

src: They will not hunger or thirst, nor will scorching heat or sun beat down on them. For He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.
tgt: Tibakoba nenchara, gose erang’o, eguru‐gura na omobaso tibikobasamba, ekiagera Omonene oria obaroreire amaabera nabaraae, nabatang’ane gochia ase chinsoko chi’amaache.

src: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.
tgt: Agakora chibonyi inye korwa ase etaabu enyititoire, agachibeeka ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera rikere.

src: They will be My people, and I will be their God.
tgt: Barabwo mbabe abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo.

src: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while'? We don't know what he is saying.”
tgt: Nabo bagateeba, “Ing'ana ki eri agoteeba, ng'a nkere ekero egeke? Titomanyeti eri agokwana.”

src: Wakaendelea kuulizana, “Ana maana gani asemapo, ‘Kitambo kidogo'? Hatuelewi hilo analosema.”
tgt: Nabo bagateeba, “Ing'ana ki eri agoteeba, ng'a nkere ekero egeke? Titomanyeti eri agokwana.”

src: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for three days, but didn't find him.
tgt: Korende ekero bagendererete komobooria, ere akarosa, agateeba: “Batome rende.” Barabwo bagatoma abanto emerongo etano, bagachia komorigia ase engaki y'amatuko atato, tibamonyora.

src: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
tgt: Erio Yeso agatiga emeganda, akagenda nyomba. Aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakobora, “Totebererie omobayeeno bw'amabanchore a mogondo.”

src: Kisha Yesu akaagana na makutano, akaingia nyumbani. Wanafunzi wake wakamjia wakamwambia, “Tueleze maana ya ule mfano wa magugu shambani.”
tgt: Erio Yeso agatiga emeganda, akagenda nyomba. Aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakobora, “Totebererie omobayeeno bw'amabanchore a mogondo.”

src: “Who is this man who told you to pick it up and walk?” they asked.
tgt: Bakamobooria, “Oria ogoteebia: Etweke egesero kiao ogende, nere ng’o?”

src: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
tgt: Omoyo one oganyoire ase okogania ogotooreka kwao, nigo 'nsemeretie ring'ana riao.

src: And the priest is to examine the mildew and isolate the contaminated fabric for seven days.
tgt: Omokuani areenge egento kere na ukoma, erio akebeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.

src: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
tgt: Bono ing'iranerie onye gokonyara; beka amang'ana ao ang'e, otenene bokong'u!

src: A man who looks to the table of another, his life is not to be considered a life. He will pollute his soul with another person's food, but a wise and well-instructed person will beware of that.
tgt: Ekero omonto akomosemeria oyonde amoe endagera, ere nigo akomenya obogima botagwenereti Mwanyabaanto. Ogosemeria endagera y'omonto onde nokwea obosooku; omonto oorokereirie naende omong'aini, ere nigo akobwebachera obogima bonga buna obwo.

src: Mtu anayetazama meza ya mtu mwingine, maisha yake hayapaswi kuchukuliwa kama maisha. Atachafua roho yake kwa chakula cha mtu mwingine, lakini mtu mwenye busara na elimu atajihadhari na hilo.
tgt: Ekero omonto akomosemeria oyonde amoe endagera, ere nigo akomenya obogima botagwenereti Mwanyabaanto. Ogosemeria endagera y'omonto onde nokwea obosooku; omonto oorokereirie naende omong'aini, ere nigo akobwebachera obogima bonga buna obwo.

src: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh's house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God's house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;
tgt: Naende akamoa omogwekano bw'ebinto bionsi arengereretie igoro y'okoagacha chiraaro chi'enyomba y'Omonene, na obw'ebinyomba bionsi biraetanane Hekalu biagachwe ase chimonga chi'enyomba ya Nyasae chiragachwe, amo ne chikungo chi'ebiegwa biare gocha gwatananwa bibe ebichenu.

src: Akampa vielelezo vya yote Roho alikuwa ameviweka moyoni mwake kwa ajili ya kumbi za Hekalu la Bwana na vyumba vyote vilivyolizunguka, kwa ajili ya hazina za Hekalu la Mungu na kwa hazina za vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu.
tgt: Naende akamoa omogwekano bw'ebinto bionsi arengereretie igoro y'okoagacha chiraaro chi'enyomba y'Omonene, na obw'ebinyomba bionsi biraetanane Hekalu biagachwe ase chimonga chi'enyomba ya Nyasae chiragachwe, amo ne chikungo chi'ebiegwa biare gocha gwatananwa bibe ebichenu.

src: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
tgt: Abwo nigo bagwasamia emenwa yabo bateeba: “Ahaa! Ahaa! Ntwayarora namaiso aito.”

src: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;
tgt: Erio orobebe rokaonchoka gochia Rama, rogaika omochie omonene o Turo, oyogiteire chindwaki, rokaonchoka gochia Hosa, na rokanucha Enyancha Enene. Naende orogongo orwo rokabwaterania engegu y'ensemo y'Akisibu,

src: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God's house, cut the vessels of God's house in pieces, and shut up the doors of Yahweh's house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
tgt: Ahasi agasangereria ebikorero bi'enyomba ya Nyasae, akabinachana ebing'ese, erio agasieka ebisieri bi'enyomba y'Omonene, akayeroiseria ebisasimero aase ande onsi agwo Yerusalemu.

src: But if He should say, ‘I do not delight in you,’ then here I am; let Him do to me whatever seems good to Him.”
tgt: Korende karanteebie ng’a timogwenereti, inche nao inde aa, ankorere aya ararore are amaya ase are.”

src: Lakini kama yeye atasema, ‘Mimi sipendezwi nawe,’ basi mimi niko tayari; yeye na anifanye chochote aonacho chema kwake.”
tgt: Korende karanteebie ng’a timogwenereti, inche nao inde aa, ankorere aya ararore are amaya ase are.”

src: who is not partial to princes and does not favor rich over poor? For they are all the work of His hands.
tgt: Nyasae tari gwanchereria abagaambi, gose tari kobara abanda ng’a mbare nengencho enene kobua abataka, ekiagera abwo bonsi nigo bare emeremo y’amaboko aye.

src: I alone decreed and saved and proclaimed— I, and not some foreign god among you. So you are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “that I am God.
tgt: Nigo narentete ogotooreka, nkabarareria ayio, nainwe mokayaigwa, na enyasae engeni tiyarenge ase egati yaino; inwe nigo more birori baane ng’a inche ninche Nyasae.” Naboigo Omonene atebiire.

src: A faithful wife gives joy to her husband. He will fulfill his years in peace.
tgt: Omokungu omwegenwa nigo are omogooko ase omosacha oye; omosacha oyio nigo aramenye nomorembe emiaka yaye yonsi.

src: Mke mwaminifu humfurahisha mumewe, naye atatimiza miaka yake kwa amani.
tgt: Omokungu omwegenwa nigo are omogooko ase omosacha oye; omosacha oyio nigo aramenye nomorembe emiaka yaye yonsi.

src: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn't recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”
tgt: Korende nabateebirie ng'a Elija oikire gocha; na barabwo tibamomanyete, korende bakamokorera onsi aya barigetie. Naboigo n'Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nachie konyora emechando ase amaboko abo.”

src: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down— he who accuses them day and night before our God.
tgt: Nkaigwa eriogi rinene igoro rigoteeba, “Bono ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito gwachire amo ne chinguru na oborwoti bwaye, na okobua gwa Kristo oye, ekiagera omosoeri bw’abaminto orutirwe inse, ere oyorenge kobasoera ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito omobaso na obotuko.

src: Kisha nikasikia sauti kuu mbinguni, ikisema: “Sasa wokovu na uweza na Ufalme wa Mungu wetu umekuja na mamlaka ya Kristo wake. Kwa kuwa ametupwa chini mshtaki wa ndugu zetu, anayewashtaki mbele za Mungu usiku na mchana.
tgt: Nkaigwa eriogi rinene igoro rigoteeba, “Bono ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito gwachire amo ne chinguru na oborwoti bwaye, na okobua gwa Kristo oye, ekiagera omosoeri bw’abaminto orutirwe inse, ere oyorenge kobasoera ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito omobaso na obotuko.

src: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
tgt: oinyoire obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe, na obwegenwa bwaye, obwo aorogetie ase Abaisraeli. Chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense chiarorire ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito.

src: Meanwhile, those in the ambush came out of the city against them, and the men of Ai were trapped between the Israelite forces on both sides. So Israel struck them down until no survivor or fugitive remained.
tgt: Abaisraeli abarenge ase omochie ime bagatirimboka gochiao. Ase igo abanto ba Ai bagaetananwa kegima n’Abaisraeli, na bonsi bagaitwa. Onde tatigarete otooregete,

src: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.
tgt: Bakaroka Barnaba Zeu, na Paulo Herme, ekiagera nere orenge omonene ase ogokwana.

src: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;
tgt: Na oyo obusuirwe ase egetare nere oria okoigwa ring'ana, erio kegima oribwata nomogooko,

src: Therefore a lion from the forest will strike them down, a wolf from the desert will ravage them. A leopard will lie in wait near their cities, and everyone who ventures out will be torn to pieces. For their rebellious acts are many, and their unfaithful deeds are numerous.
tgt: Ase engencho eyio endo nerue rinani ebaite; esese y’orosana nerue erooro ebasirie; engo nebaboere ase emechie yabo. Kera omonto ogosoka korwa aroro natandoranwe, ekiagera ogosaria kwabo nokonge, na okogwa kwabo kw’ogontiga nokonene.

src: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
tgt: Aye Omonene, Nyasae omwegenwa, naye kwambooririe.

src: Ninaikabidhi roho yangu mikononi mwako, unikomboe Ee Bwana, uliye Mungu wa kweli.
tgt: Aye Omonene, Nyasae omwegenwa, naye kwambooririe.

src: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
tgt: inche nachieire obogima bwa kare na kare, na chirochio tichigosira nonya ng'ake, nonya nomonto tagochitaboria korwa ase okoboko kwane.

src: nami ninawapa uzima wa milele, hawataangamia kamwe wala hakuna mtu atakayewapokonya kutoka mikono yangu.
tgt: inche nachieire obogima bwa kare na kare, na chirochio tichigosira nonya ng'ake, nonya nomonto tagochitaboria korwa ase okoboko kwane.

src: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don't bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”
tgt: Ekero moraike ang'e n'ense y'Abaamoni, abanto b'ororeeria rwa Loti, timobaisa kobachegia gose kobarwania esegi, ekiagera tinkobaa inwe nonya n'enseemo eyemo y'orogongo orwo nabaeire barabwo.”

src: For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn't concealed from my eyes.
tgt: Amaiso aane nigo aroche chinchera chiabo chionsi. Tibakonyara kwebisa korwa ase 'nde. Nigo ndoche ebibe biabo.

src: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!' and tell the south, ‘Don't hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
tgt: Nintebie chinse chia sugusu: Tiga abanto baane barue agwo, ne chinse chia Irianyi: Timobatanga! Renta abamura baane korwa aare, na abaiseke baane korwa ase chinsinyo chi'ense.

src: Nitaiambia kaskazini, ‘Watoe!' nayo kusini, ‘Usiwazuie.' Walete wana wangu kutoka mbali, na binti zangu kutoka miisho ya dunia:
tgt: Nintebie chinse chia sugusu: Tiga abanto baane barue agwo, ne chinse chia Irianyi: Timobatanga! Renta abamura baane korwa aare, na abaiseke baane korwa ase chinsinyo chi'ense.

src: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they remain in their strongholds. Their might has failed. They have become as women. Her dwelling places are set on fire. Her bars are broken.
tgt: Abarwani chituoni ba Babiloni batigire korwana esegi. Nigo bagendererete kobeera ase chiburi ime, ekiagera tibari ne chinguru, babeire buna abakungu. Chinyomba chia Babiloni chiasambirwe, na emekorogoto yabo y'ebiita yabunirwe.

src: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
tgt: Omonene atogigwe, rituko ase rituko nigo agotobogoreria chigurube chiaito. Nyasae nere ogotooreka gwaito.

src: Sifa apewe Bwana, Mungu Mwokozi wetu, ambaye siku kwa siku hutuchukulia mizigo yetu.
tgt: Omonene atogigwe, rituko ase rituko nigo agotobogoreria chigurube chiaito. Nyasae nere ogotooreka gwaito.

src: The house was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the pillars—forty-five beams, fifteen per row.
tgt: Enyomba nigo yareenge nekerama ki’emecharake igoro y’emiamba yabegetwe ase chisiiro chiria emerongo ene na isano, ikomi na isano ase kera orwaro.

src: In all the things that you have brought upon us, and upon the holy city of our fathers, Jerusalem, you have executed true judgments. For according to truth and justice you have brought all these things upon us because of our sins.
tgt: Nigo gwakorete eri riarenge rironge ekeene kwaretete emechando ase Yerusalemu, omochie omochenu bw'echisokoro chiaito. Egesusuro ekio nigo giatobwenerete ase engencho y'ebibe biaito.

src: Katika mambo yote uliyotuletea sisi, na juu ya mji mtakatifu wa baba zetu, Yerusalemu, umetekeleza hukumu za kweli. Kwa maana kwa mujibu wa kweli na haki umetuletea mambo haya yote kwa sababu ya dhambi zetu.
tgt: Nigo gwakorete eri riarenge rironge ekeene kwaretete emechando ase Yerusalemu, omochie omochenu bw'echisokoro chiaito. Egesusuro ekio nigo giatobwenerete ase engencho y'ebibe biaito.

src: Can you hunt the prey for a lioness or satisfy the hunger of young lions
tgt: Inee! Nonyare gotwarera endo ebi ekoria, gose koigotia chindo chinsae chiganetie endagera,

src: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
tgt: Echi nachio chiamate chi'egesaku kia Gadi. Abaabaretwe nigo barenge chilifi emerongo ene, na amagana atano (40,500).

src: Pray to the LORD, for there has been enough of God’s thunder and hail. I will let you go; you do not need to stay any longer.”
tgt: Nsabere ase Omonene. Chinkoba echi amo nembura y’amagena biatonyarire. Nimbae ribaga mogende, timogwenereti mobeere aa goetania.”

src: Mwombeni Bwana, kwa kuwa tumepata ngurumo na mvua za mawe za kututosha. Nitawaachia mwondoke; hamtahitaji kungoja zaidi.”
tgt: Nsabere ase Omonene. Chinkoba echi amo nembura y’amagena biatonyarire. Nimbae ribaga mogende, timogwenereti mobeere aa goetania.”

src: They set up the altar on its foundation and sacrificed burnt offerings on it to the LORD—both the morning and evening burnt offerings—even though they feared the people of the land.
tgt: Bakaagacha egesasiimero keria aase aye, erinde bamoruere Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa mambia na morogoba, ekiagera nigo bairogete abanto bamenyete ase ense eria.

src: For before the harvest, when the blossom is gone and the flower becomes a ripening grape, He will cut off the shoots with a pruning knife and remove and discard the branches.
tgt: Ekero chindagera chiakoorire gosicha ne rigesa ritaraika, na amasabibu achakire kwama, Omonene nasose chinsagia nomoyio enkuro, na ebisebo bigokina abirusieo.

src: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, David’s wife, to Palti son of Laish, who was from Gallim.
tgt: Saulo konya orure Mikali, omosubati oye, oyorenge moga Daudi, ase Paliti, mosinto o Laisi bw’omochie o Galimu.

src: Then Jezebel wrote letters in Ahab’s name, sealed them with his seal, and sent them to the elders and nobles who lived with Naboth in his city.
tgt: Ase ayio omokungu oria akarika amarube, akabeeka erieta ri’Ahabu na ekemanyererio kiaye ase amarube ayio, akayatoma gochia ase abagaaka, na ase abanene baria bamenyete amo na Naboti ase omochie oye.

src: Kwa hiyo akaandika barua kwa jina la Ahabu akaweka muhuri wake juu ya hizo barua, akazipeleka kwa wazee na kwa watu wenye cheo walioishi katika mji pamoja na Nabothi.
tgt: Ase ayio omokungu oria akarika amarube, akabeeka erieta ri’Ahabu na ekemanyererio kiaye ase amarube ayio, akayatoma gochia ase abagaaka, na ase abanene baria bamenyete amo na Naboti ase omochie oye.

src: He will scourge us for our iniquities, and will again show mercy, and will gather us out of all the nations among whom you are all scattered.
tgt: Nonya gakobaa egesusuro ase engencho y'obobe bwaino, nabarorere amaabera inwe mwensi; nabasangererie korwa ase kera egesaku korwa kera ase mwasiareretwe.

src: Atatupiga kwa ajili ya maovu yetu, na kutuonyesha rehema tena, na kutukusanya kutoka katika mataifa yote ambayo nyote mmetawanyika kati yao.
tgt: Nonya gakobaa egesusuro ase engencho y'obobe bwaino, nabarorere amaabera inwe mwensi; nabasangererie korwa ase kera egesaku korwa kera ase mwasiareretwe.

src: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.
tgt: Korende onye bakwanga kwerua abanyene ase more, korende baabarwanie esegi, rirorio moire omochie obo na komenyao.

src: There were three rows of high windows facing one another in three tiers.
tgt: Enyomba eyio nigo yareenge nebibao bire ase chindwaro isato, kera ekebao kerigereretie ekende.

src: Madirisha yake yaliwekwa juu kwa safu tatu, yakielekeana.
tgt: Enyomba eyio nigo yareenge nebibao bire ase chindwaro isato, kera ekebao kerigereretie ekende.

src: And I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm, with anger, fury, and great wrath.
tgt: Inche omonyene mbarwanie inwe nokoboko kwane kore ne chinguru, imbe nendamwamu, na obotindi, na okogechigwa okonene.

src: Mimi mwenyewe nitapigana dhidi yenu kwa mkono wangu ulionyooshwa na mkono wa nguvu, kwa hasira na ghadhabu kali na ukali mwingi.
tgt: Inche omonyene mbarwanie inwe nokoboko kwane kore ne chinguru, imbe nendamwamu, na obotindi, na okogechigwa okonene.

tgt: Naende Daudi akamobooria, “Amoteebie buna amang'ana agendererete aria.” Omonto oria akamoiraneria, “Abanto abange batamire korwa ase esegi eria, na abande abange mono baitirwe bakuure. Boigo Saulo amo na Yonathani, momura oye, baitirwe bakuure.”

src: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies and gave each man a ram’s horn in one hand and a large jar in the other, containing a torch.
tgt: Agaatanana abanto baria baye amagana atato ase ebiombe bitato, akaa kera oyomo egetuureri, na ekeguuru amo n’ekemoreki ki’omorero kere imeo.

src: Akawagawa wale watu 300 katika makundi matatu, akawakabidhi tarumbeta mikononi mwao wote na mitungi isiyokuwa na maji yenye mienge ndani yake.
tgt: Agaatanana abanto baria baye amagana atato ase ebiombe bitato, akaa kera oyomo egetuureri, na ekeguuru amo n’ekemoreki ki’omorero kere imeo.

src: By this they are known not to be gods. Therefore don't fear them.
tgt: Chinyasae echio chikaransete ase chikaru chiabo nigo chire bosa buna enyongo yategete. Amaiso abo nigo aichire ebuse eyio abanto bagwetinyia amagoro ekero bagosoa hekalu ime.

src: Kwa hili wanajulikana kuwa si miungu. Kwa hivyo msiwaogope.
tgt: Chinyasae echio chikaransete ase chikaru chiabo nigo chire bosa buna enyongo yategete. Amaiso abo nigo aichire ebuse eyio abanto bagwetinyia amagoro ekero bagosoa hekalu ime.

src: They are also to fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the young woman’s father, because this man has given a virgin of Israel a bad name. And she shall remain his wife; he must not divorce her as long as he lives.
tgt: Naende bamonachere aakane, chitaabu, chisekeli chi’echifeta rigana erimo, amoe ise omoiseke oria, ekiagera osaririe erieta ri’omoiseke omwekungi bw’Abaisraeli. Erio oria agenderere koba mokaaye, na omosacha oye tabaisa komotiga nonya ng’ake ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.

src: In those days Hezekiah became mortally ill. So he prayed to the LORD, who spoke to him and gave him a sign.
tgt: Ase amatuko aria Hezekia akarwara, akaba ang’e nogokwa. Agasaba Omonene, na ere akamoiraneria ase okomworokia ekemanyererio.

src: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
tgt: Omonto nigo akonyora egesusuro gi'okomoorongeyia, ekero are nobororo ase oborere bwaye, na amauga aye agendererete komwatia.

src: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
tgt: Naboigo natonyore oyomo okobwatana naitwe koba kirori ase okobokigwa kw’omonene oito Yeso Kristo. Ere goika abe korwa ase egati yabaanto barenge gotaara amo naintwe ase ekero gionsi eki Omonene Yeso arenge gosoa na gosoka ase egati yaito,

src: Kwa hiyo inatubidi tumchague mtu mwingine miongoni mwa wale ambao wamekuwa pamoja nasi wakati wote Bwana Yesu alipoingia na kutoka katikati yenu,
tgt: Naboigo natonyore oyomo okobwatana naitwe koba kirori ase okobokigwa kw’omonene oito Yeso Kristo. Ere goika abe korwa ase egati yabaanto barenge gotaara amo naintwe ase ekero gionsi eki Omonene Yeso arenge gosoa na gosoka ase egati yaito,

src: They have ears, but they don't hear. They have noses, but they don't smell.
tgt: Nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, nebwate emioro, korende teri konyonka eigwe rimisu.

src: zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia, zina pua, lakini haziwezi kunusa;
tgt: Nebwate amato, korende teri koigwa, nebwate emioro, korende teri konyonka eigwe rimisu.

src: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;
tgt: Korende nindigetie ng'a timoba nogwechanda. Oyotaranyuoma nigo arengereretie amang'ana 'Omonene, buna aragwenere Omonene:

src: Ningetaka msiwe na masumbufu. Mwanaume ambaye hajaoa anajishughulisha na mambo ya Bwana, jinsi ya kumpendeza Bwana.
tgt: Korende nindigetie ng'a timoba nogwechanda. Oyotaranyuoma nigo arengereretie amang'ana 'Omonene, buna aragwenere Omonene:

src: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!
tgt: “Naki anga yaba buya, onye nkwambisa agwo aase abakuure; onye kwandenda aase are bobisi, goika endamwamu yao ebe yaetire, onye gwanchikera engaki na kong'inyora!

src: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come to her from the north,” says Yahweh.
tgt: Erio igoro na ense, na ebinto bionsi bireo, mbitere nomochengo, ekero abasaria bararue sugusu gocha gosaria Babiloni. Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.

src: And the waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible. Noah Sends a Raven and a Dove
tgt: Na amaache akagenderera gokea goika omotienyi o ikomi. Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi ebichuria bi’ebitunwa bikarorekana.

src: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
tgt: Akaonchoka ekieni kiaye ase bare, obosio bwaye bokagirigenta buna erioba, ne chianga chiaye chikaraba buna omobaso.

src: Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his servants, his commanders, and his officials all surrendered to the king of Babylon. So in the eighth year of his reign, the king of Babylon took him captive.
tgt: Erio Yehoyakini, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, akerua ase omorwoti o Babiloni, ere omonyene, na ng’ina, na abasomba baye, na abanene baria bare komokoonya, na abanene b’enyomba yaye. Ase omwaka o gatano na gatato bw’okogaamba kwaye, omorwoti o Babiloni akaira Yehoyakini akamosiba,

src: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.”
tgt: Aborokigwa baye bakamoteebia, “Omonene, onye orarire, nagwene.”

src: They entered into the covenant to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;
tgt: Bagakora okobwatana kw'ogotianania ng'a bamorigie Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi, na emioyo yabo yonsi.

src: How can we sing Yahweh's song in a foreign land?
tgt: Naki torakore totere ogoteera kw'Omonene ase ense engeni?

src: The leaders of Shechem set up an ambush against Abimelech on the hilltops, and they robbed all who passed by them on the road. So this was reported to Abimelech.
tgt: Abanto ba Sekemu bakabeeka abanto ase ebitunwa igoro baboere abanto bonsi barenge goeta ase chinchera chiria na kobaura ebinto biabo. Abimeleki agateebigwa amang’ana ayio.

src: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Hold out your battle lance toward Ai, for into your hand I will deliver the city.” So Joshua held out his battle lance toward Ai,
tgt: Omonene agateebia Yoshua, “Raga ne ritimo riao rire koboko kwao gochia Ai, ekiagera ninkoe omochie oyo ase amaboko ao.” Yoshua akaraga omochie ne ritimo abwate koboko kwaye.

src: Foreigners cower before me; when they hear me, they obey me.
tgt: Abamenyi nigo bebeegete inse y’ane, na ekero baigure chinkuma chiane, banyigwera.

src: Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.
tgt: Ase okorora kwane naroche chibarasi amo nabwo bachiriinete koba buna iga: Abariini nigo baare ne chingobo chi’ebioma ase ebikuba biabo chire nekieni ki’omorero, na ekemunsi, na ekemonuri. Chibarasi nigo chiarenge nemetwe enga buna eye chindo, na korwa ase emenwa yabo bikarua omorero, na erioki, na ekebiriti.

src: Joakim the high priest, who was in those days at Jerusalem, wrote to those who lived in Bethulia and Betomesthaim, which is opposite Esdraelon toward the plain that is near to Dothaim,
tgt: Omokuani omonene Yohakimu oyoreenge ase omochie omonene o Yerusalemu ase chingaki echio, akabariikera abanto bamenyete ase emechie ya Bethulia na Betomesthaimu, ang'e ne Esdreloni ase ense omweya ere ang'e nomochie o Dothaimu.

src: Kuhani mkuu Yoakimu, aliyekuwa Yerusalemu siku hizo, aliwaandikia wale walioishi Bethulia na Betomesthaimu, iliyo mkabala na Esdraeloni kuelekea uwanda ulio karibu na Dothaimu,
tgt: Omokuani omonene Yohakimu oyoreenge ase omochie omonene o Yerusalemu ase chingaki echio, akabariikera abanto bamenyete ase emechie ya Bethulia na Betomesthaimu, ang'e ne Esdreloni ase ense omweya ere ang'e nomochie o Dothaimu.

src: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
tgt: Ekero abamalaika abwo bachia koimoka kogenda igoro, abarisia baria bagateebania, “Gaki togende goika Bethlehemu, torore ring’ana eri riakorekire, eri Omonene atomanyirie.”

src: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
tgt: Omonto omong'aini nigo akororera emechando korwa aare, bwebisa, korende oy'otamanyeti amaange nigo akogeenderera gochia bosio, oumerana nero, erio ochaandeka.

src: For when the people were counted, none of the residents of Jabesh-gilead were there.
tgt: Ekero abanto baare koroberigwa na goitaagwa, bakanyoora ng’a onde taacheteo nonya n’oyomo korwa ase abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi,

src: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
tgt: Akarigereria Yeso ogotaara, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae!”

src: in order that the crime against the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come to justice and their blood be avenged on their brother Abimelech and on the leaders of Shechem, who had helped him murder his brothers.
tgt: Aya nigo abeete bo, erinde obobe obwo bwakoreretwe abana abamura baria ba Yerubi‐Baali emerongo etano n’ebere boakanerwe egesiomba. Ase igo okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga abo kogaakanerwa igoro y’Abimeleki, oyio obaitete, naende igoro y’ abanto ba Sekemu, abwo bamobegete chinguru chi’ogokora ayio.

src: Hili lilitokea ili ule ukatili waliotendewa hao wana sabini wa Yerub-Baali upatilizwe, na damu yao iwe juu ya Abimeleki ndugu yao aliyewaua, na pia iwe juu ya watu wa Shekemu, ambao walimsaidia kuua ndugu zake.
tgt: Aya nigo abeete bo, erinde obobe obwo bwakoreretwe abana abamura baria ba Yerubi‐Baali emerongo etano n’ebere boakanerwe egesiomba. Ase igo okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga abo kogaakanerwa igoro y’Abimeleki, oyio obaitete, naende igoro y’ abanto ba Sekemu, abwo bamobegete chinguru chi’ogokora ayio.

src: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God's Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.
tgt: Kobachorire rituko nere, abanto abange mono bagacha asare aase amenyete. Akabateebereria korwa mambia goika mogoroba, na koorokia amang'ana igoro y'oborwoti bwa Nyasae, agateema kobateebereria amang'ana igoro ya Yeso korwa ase amang'ana 'amachiiko a Musa na korwa ase ababani.

src: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”
tgt: Bagakumia bonsi, bagaichana na koborania: “Amang'ana aya, engencho yaye ninki?”

src: So this man also died like this, leaving his death for an example of nobleness and a memorial of virtue, not only to the young but also to the great body of his nation.
tgt: Ase igo Eliazari agakwa. Korende ogokwa kwaye kw'oboremu gokaba gokainyorwa buna egento ki'engencho ase ense yonsi.

src: Kwa hivyo mtu huyu pia alikufa hivi, akiacha kifo chake kama mfano wa utukufu na ukumbusho wa wema, si kwa vijana tu bali pia kwa kundi kubwa la taifa lake.
tgt: Ase igo Eliazari agakwa. Korende ogokwa kwaye kw'oboremu gokaba gokainyorwa buna egento ki'engencho ase ense yonsi.

src: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to Yahweh against you, and it be sin to you.
tgt: Mwerende mono, timobaisa kwanga koa omotaka oyio egento na goteeba: Omwaka bw'okwabera chisiira obeire ang'e. Timobia ebirengererio ebibe buna ebio ribaga ase chinkoro chiaino. Onye mokoba abang'iti na kwanga koa oyomino ore omotaka egento, ere narere ase Omonene, ekiagera mwamorinire eki aremeire, nainwe 'namobe n'ebibe.

src: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
tgt: (Naki omosacha tarwete ase omokungu, korende nomokuungu orwete ase omosacha.

src: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
tgt: Akabateebia, “Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere Omonene bw'Esabato.”

src: Yesu akawaambia, “Mwana wa Adamu ndiye Bwana wa Sabato.”
tgt: Akabateebia, “Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto nere Omonene bw'Esabato.”

src: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
tgt: Korende mbuya botambe korigia omokia ase ring'ana rire rigiya, na tari ekero inde amo nainwe rioka.

src: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Micaiah daughter of Uriel; she was from Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
tgt: Akagamba ase engaki y’emiaka etato agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Mikaya, mosubati o Urieli, korwa Gibea. Esegi yarenge gati y’Abiya na Yeroboamu.

src: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
tgt: Inwe mwensi abamore abaronge, goka ase Nyasae, moake ng'a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.

src: so that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, which He is making with you today, and into His oath,
tgt: Na boono ’monyaare gosoa ase okobwatana kw’ogotianania okw’Omonene Nyasae oino, agokora amo nainwe rituko ria reero,

src: Mnasimama hapa ili kufanya Agano na Bwana Mungu wenu, Agano ambalo Mungu analifanya nanyi siku hii ya leo na kulitia muhuri kwa kiapo,
tgt: Na boono ’monyaare gosoa ase okobwatana kw’ogotianania okw’Omonene Nyasae oino, agokora amo nainwe rituko ria reero,

src: Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion.
tgt: Abanto abwo bagosasiima emegwekano eyio ere bosa barabwo batigire oboigweri gocha ase ore.

src: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.
tgt: Naende akaroisia chimesa ikomi, agachibeka ime ase Hekalu isano ensemo ya borio, na isano ensemo ya bomosi; akaroisia ne chisani rigana erimo korwa ase chitaabu.

src: You may present as a freewill offering an ox or sheep that has a deformed or stunted limb, but it is not acceptable in fulfillment of a vow.
tgt: Eeri gose emaanwa y’eng’ondi ebwate ekiimo egetambe goetania ekende, gose ekieng’e mono, nabo oranyare koyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogwancha, korende ase okoyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogoikerania eira kwariete, tegwancherwa nainche.

src: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
tgt: Barabwo tibari gosookigwa ase chingaki chi’amabe, ase chingaki chi’enchara nigo bakoigota.

src: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:
tgt: Aya naro amang'ana y'omoerio a Daudi, mosinto o Yese, omonto oyo oimokereretigwe igoro, omoakwa amaguta o Nyasae o Yakobo, omoteri bw'amatera agwansa ase Abaisraeli:

src: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
tgt: Aye Omonene, tokonyaara gotiga eira eyio kwarierete Daudi ase ogotiana, ogateeba: “Oyomo bw'oroiboro rwao nimobeeke aikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki'obogaambi.

src: These are the family heads and genealogical records of those who returned with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:
tgt: Abanto aba nabwo abateneneri be chiamate echio chiaruete Babiloni, chigatiira amo nainche, ekero Aritasasita arenge kogamba, na oyo nomoroberio bwe chinderia chiabo:

src: Hawa ndio viongozi wa jamaa pamoja na wale walioandikwa ambao walikuja pamoja nami kutoka Babeli wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Artashasta:
tgt: Abanto aba nabwo abateneneri be chiamate echio chiaruete Babiloni, chigatiira amo nainche, ekero Aritasasita arenge kogamba, na oyo nomoroberio bwe chinderia chiabo:

src: Anna ran to him, and fell upon the neck of her son, and said to him, “I have seen you, my child! I am ready to die.” They both wept.
tgt: Ana akaminyokera omwana oye akamoboania akamonyunyuta akamoteebia, Bono ase engencho nakororire kore moyo naende omwana one nabo ngokwa, erio akaiyeria amariga y'omogooko.

src: Anna alimkimbilia, akaanguka shingoni mwa mwanawe, akamwambia, "Nimekuona, mwanangu! Niko tayari kufa." Wote wawili walilia.
tgt: Ana akaminyokera omwana oye akamoboania akamonyunyuta akamoteebia, Bono ase engencho nakororire kore moyo naende omwana one nabo ngokwa, erio akaiyeria amariga y'omogooko.

src: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
tgt: Omonene nigo are omuya na ere nere omonyene oboronge, ase ayio nigo akworokereria abanyabibe enchera bagwenerete kobwatia.

src: Bwana ni mwema na mwenye adili, kwa hiyo huwafundisha wenye dhambi njia zake.
tgt: Omonene nigo are omuya na ere nere omonyene oboronge, ase ayio nigo akworokereria abanyabibe enchera bagwenerete kobwatia.

src: I do all this for the sake of the gospel, so that I may share in its blessings. Run Your Race to Win
tgt: Na inche nigo ngokora aya onsi ase engencho y’enchiri, erinde inyare koba oyomo obo bw’abakonyora ogosesenigwa kwaye. Omokia ogwenerete ase obobui

src: From ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.
tgt: Korwa amatuko a kare onde tana koigwa nogoto kwaye, gose korora neriso riaye, Nyasae onga buna aye ogokorera abwo bagosemeretie amaya.

src: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.
tgt: Magega ase aya akaorokera abanto babere ase barabwo, ore nekieni kende ekeao, ekero barenge gotaara kogenda borabu.

src: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech,
tgt: Onye abanto b’ense yaino bakoombia, tibaita omonto oyio orure oyomo bw’abana baye ase enyasae Moleki,

src: Ikiwa watu wa jumuiya watafumba macho wakati mtu huyo anapomtoa mmoja wa watoto wake kwa mungu Moleki, nao wakaacha kumuua,
tgt: Onye abanto b’ense yaino bakoombia, tibaita omonto oyio orure oyomo bw’abana baye ase enyasae Moleki,

src: He roams the mountains for pasture, searching for any green thing.
tgt: Nigo ekona‐kogenda aaria na aaria ase ebitunwa ekorisia, yaba ekorigia kera ekemeri ekebese.

src: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”
tgt: Erio Simioni Petero akamoteebia, “Omonene, tari amagoro aane oka, korende nonya namaboko na omotwe one.”

src: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples.
tgt: Inwe mwaimokirie chifeta ne chitaabu chiane, na mwairire ebinto biane ebiya bingwenerete gochia ase chikalu chiaino.

src: The LORD is angry with all the nations and furious with all their armies. He will devote them to destruction; He will give them over to slaughter.
tgt: Omonene obeire nendamwamu enene ase ebisaku bionsi, na obeire nekeririanda ase emeganda yabo yonsi y’esegi; obanacheire ekiina gi’okobasiria, obarure baitwe.

src: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master's son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master's son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
tgt: Aye, amo n'abana bao na abasomba bao 'mobe mokomoremera emegondo. Norentere omoochokoro bw'omonene oo okwama korwa mogondo, erinde anyore endagera, korende Mefiboseti omonyene, omoochokoro bw'omonene oo, nigo arabe okoragera ase emesa y'ane botambe.” Siba nigo abwate abamura ikomi na batano na abasomba emerongo ebere.

src: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
tgt: Namanyire, naende naenekirie ase Omonene Yeso, ng'a gento kende tikeri ekebe ekenyene, korende nigo kere ekebe ase oyo okeroche ng'a negento ekebe.

src: Ninajua tena nimehakikishiwa sana katika Bwana Yesu kwamba hakuna kitu chochote ambacho ni najisi kwa asili yake. Lakini kama mtu anakiona kitu kuwa ni najisi, basi kwake huyo kitu hicho ni najisi.
tgt: Namanyire, naende naenekirie ase Omonene Yeso, ng'a gento kende tikeri ekebe ekenyene, korende nigo kere ekebe ase oyo okeroche ng'a negento ekebe.

src: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?
tgt: Inee! Amagena 'embura a Lebanoni ana koruao atige ebitare bia igoro? Gose ebirooche bikorwa ase ebitare biana koborwa amaache amakendu?

src: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Thanksgiving (Philippians 1:3–11; Colossians 1:3–14)
tgt: Obuya na omorembe bibe ase more, ebio bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ogosesenigwa ase Kristo

src: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi. Shukrani
tgt: Obuya na omorembe bibe ase more, ebio bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo. Ogosesenigwa ase Kristo

tgt: Omoroberio bw'Abalawi abarenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo okarikwa ase Egetabu ki'amang'ana 'Ebiro goikera ase amatuko a Yohanani, mosinto bw'Eliasibu.

src: Wakuu wa jamaa miongoni mwa wazao wa Lawi hadi wakati wa Yohanani mwana wa Eliashibu waliandikishwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu.
tgt: Omoroberio bw'Abalawi abarenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo okarikwa ase Egetabu ki'amang'ana 'Ebiro goikera ase amatuko a Yohanani, mosinto bw'Eliasibu.

src: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.
tgt: Omonto oyio nagenderere gosesenigwa, na ororeria rwaye ndoire ense.

src: They did not understand that He was telling them about the Father.
tgt: Tibamanya ng’a nigo are gokwana ase bare aya Ise.

src: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?
tgt: Ekero Petero arora aya akaboria abanto: “Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, inki mogokumeria aya gose nase ki inwe mogotobeta amaiso, ng'a buna intwe ase chinguru chiaito abanyene, gose ase obuya bwaito, twamokora oyo ogenda?

src: Jehoiada took for himself two wives, and he had sons and daughters.
tgt: Yehoyada akamonyuomeria abakungu babere, na barabwo bakamoiborera abana, abamura na abaiseke.

src: Do I not have the right to do as I please with what is mine? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
tgt: Inee! Tindi neribaga gokora buna ndigetie omonyene n’ebinto biane? Gose naki okorigereria neriso riibe, ekiagera inche inde omuya?

src: Je, sina haki yangu kufanya kile nitakacho na mali yangu mwenyewe? Au unaona wivu kwa kuwa nimekuwa mkarimu?’
tgt: Inee! Tindi neribaga gokora buna ndigetie omonyene n’ebinto biane? Gose naki okorigereria neriso riibe, ekiagera inche inde omuya?

src: And now, would you turn away from the LORD? If you rebel today against the LORD, tomorrow He will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.
tgt: Inee! Na bono inwe motagete gotiga Omonene? Onye mokwanga reero koigwera Omonene, ekeene, ankio nigo arabe nekeririanda ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli.

src: That same day a Benjamite ran from the battle line all the way to Shiloh, with his clothes torn and dirt on his head.
tgt: Omonto oyomo bw’egesaku kia Benjamini agatama korwa ase esegi, akaminyoka gochia Silo, agaikao rituko erio erio, ore ne chianga chiatandoire, na obegete ebuse ase omotwe oye.

src: The waters receded steadily from the earth, and after 150 days the waters had gone down.
tgt: na amaache akana gokeea ng’ora ng’ora korwa ase ense, na ekero amatuko rigana erimo, na emerongo etano (150) aerete, amaache aria agakea.

src: One of you will say to me, “Then why does God still find fault? For who can resist His will?”
tgt: Aande gose nonteebie, “Nase ki nonya mbono Nyasae akonyora okomocha ase Mwanyabaanto? Inaki ning’o oranyare koamereria okorigia kwaye?”

src: My transgression would be sealed in a bag, and You would cover over my iniquity.
tgt: Ogosaria kwane kware komumekerigwa egunia ime, aye nigo kware gotuba ebibe biane.

src: He shall wave the sheaf before Yahweh, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
tgt: Ase rituko rigotunyana eri'Esabato Omokuani asungusie riboa erio ase obosio bwane, erio monyore ogwancherwa.

src: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.
tgt: Oyo noro omobaro bw'abakuani bairanete korwa obosomba: Abwo b'ororeria rwa Yedaya be chiamate chia Yesua: amagana kianda, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batato (973);

src: The joyful tambourines have ceased; the noise of revelers has stopped; the joyful harp is silent.
tgt: Omogoko bw’eriogi rie chinchigiri oerire, na eriogi ri’abwo bagochenga riaerire, na omogooko bw’eriogi ri’amakano oerire.

src: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.
tgt: Ekero narigereretie ebitongwa biria, nkarora amagoro 'egari ane, kera okomo kore bosio bwa kera egetongwa goteneine inse.

src: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
tgt: Notache chindo na amarubi, notiringe chindo chinsae ne chinchoka.

src: but every man's servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.
tgt: korende omosomba onde bwensi omogorwa chitaabu ere ayerie gokwamwarokirie.

src: Mtumwa yeyote ambaye mmemnunua aweza kuila kama mmemtahiri,
tgt: korende omosomba onde bwensi omogorwa chitaabu ere ayerie gokwamwarokirie.

src: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
tgt: Ase ayio, korwa ase omonto oria oyomo, nonya konya obeire buna oyokuure, abanto bakaiborwa abange buna ching'enang'eni chia igoro, na buna omokenye ore ase engegu y'enyancha, otanyare kobareka.

src: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
tgt: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, tera neriogi rinene! Inwe Abaisraeli, aka eriogi! Inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, goka na gochenga ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi!

src: We were regarded by him as something worthless, and he abstains from our ways as from uncleanness. He calls the latter end of the righteous happy. He boasts that God is his father.
tgt: Ere nigo agotorora buna abanto abakorekanu na kende gionsi togokora tikeri kiya. Nigo akwerora buna Nyasae niise boigo nana kwegena buna abanyaboronge nabwo boka bagokwa bare n'omogooko.

src: Alituona kama kitu kisichofaa, naye hujiepusha na njia zetu kama uchafu. Anawaita mwisho wa wenye haki wenye furaha. Anajisifu kwamba Mungu ndiye baba yake.
tgt: Ere nigo agotorora buna abanto abakorekanu na kende gionsi togokora tikeri kiya. Nigo akwerora buna Nyasae niise boigo nana kwegena buna abanyaboronge nabwo boka bagokwa bare n'omogooko.

src: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
tgt: Erio Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, ne riire rikagetuba.

src: With you I will break in pieces the horse and his rider.
tgt: Goetera asore ninsamunyore chibarasi na abanto bachiriinete; ninsamunyore ne chigari na abagochigendia.

src: This happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into heaven.
tgt: Ring’ana eri rigakoreka ara gatato, naende ebinto biria bionsi bikang’uswa gochia igoro.

src: Jambo hili lilitokea mara tatu, ndipo kile kitu kikavutwa tena mbinguni.
tgt: Ring’ana eri rigakoreka ara gatato, naende ebinto biria bionsi bikang’uswa gochia igoro.

src: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.
tgt: Ise na ng'ina bagakumia ase aria akwanwa igoro asare.

src: Naye Yosefu na mama yake mtoto wakastaajabu kwa yale yaliyokuwa yamesemwa kumhusu huyo mtoto.
tgt: Ise na ng'ina bagakumia ase aria akwanwa igoro asare.

src: Then we will be like all the other nations, with a king to judge us, to go out before us, and to fight our battles.”
tgt: Ntorigetie koba buna ebisaku binde; ntoganetie omorwoti ogotogaambera na gototang’ana, ekero togochia korwana chiseegi chiaito.”

src: Kisha tutakuwa kama mataifa mengine yote, tukiwa na mfalme wa kutuongoza na kwenda mbele yetu na kutupigania vita vyetu.”
tgt: Ntorigetie koba buna ebisaku binde; ntoganetie omorwoti ogotogaambera na gototang’ana, ekero togochia korwana chiseegi chiaito.”

src: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.
tgt: Akabachiika bateebie Esau omonene oye iga: “Aya naro Yakobo, omosomba oo, agokwana: Nabeire nkomenya ase ense y'obogeni, ense ya Labani goika reero iga;

src: They were banished from among men, shouted down like thieves,
tgt: Abwo nigo bagoserigwa korwa ase egati y’abanto, baakerwa amariogi korwa magega na kwogererwa buna abaibi.

src: When you go to war against your enemies and the LORD your God delivers them into your hand and you take them captive,
tgt: “Ekero mokogeenda ase esegi korwania ababisa baino, n’Omonene Nyasae oino, ababeeke ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobabue na moboose,

src: Was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to God?”
tgt: Onde tanyorekanete oiranete komotogia Nyasae, otatiga omogeni oyo?”

src: When they reached the trees, the girl asked again, "Where is your firewood?" The giant answered, "Not far now!"
tgt: Ekero baigete ase emete eria, omoiseke oria akariboria naende, “Ing’ai chinko chiao chire?” Richini riria riakamoiraneria, “Tari are korwa igaa!”

src: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
tgt: Imanyie amachiiko ao, erinde ’n’yabwate na koyarenda nenkoro yane yonsi.

src: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
tgt: Nindue oborori bwao ase amasio y'abarwoti 'ntari nobosooku.

src: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.
tgt: Erio gokaba naende ogwatananekana ase Abayahudi ase engencho y'amang'ana aya.

src: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
tgt: “Tegerera moigwe, erio moche ase 'nde. Igwa! Erio nario moranyare koba moyo. Ninkore nainwe okobwatana kw'ogotianania gwa kare na kare, naende nimbaorokerie obwanchani bwane bwa botambe obo narierete Daudi eira.

src: “My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon. He is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.”
tgt: “Aye omorwoti, omonene one, abanto bakorire bobe mono ase amang'ana onsi bakorire ase Yeremia omobani ase okomobeka ime ase engoro eria. Bono ere nigo arakwereo ase engencho y'enchara, ekiagera emegati yonsi yaerire korwa ase omochie.”

src: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
tgt: Omokuani asaambere ebitinya ase egesasiimero, korende ritaana ribe eria Aroni na abamura baye.

src: who kept the law of the Most High, and was taken into covenant with him. In his flesh he established the covenant. When he was tested, he was found faithful.
tgt: Akabwatia amachiiko y'Omonene, nere Omonene agakora okobwatana nere, agaikerania ase omobere oye ekemanyererio giokobwatana okwo, boigo ekero Aburamu nigo atemetwe, akarorekana ere ore omoikeranu.

src: Aliyeishika sheria ya Aliye Juu Zaidi, akaingizwa katika agano naye. Alithibitisha agano katika mwili wake. Alipojaribiwa, alionekana kuwa mwaminifu.
tgt: Akabwatia amachiiko y'Omonene, nere Omonene agakora okobwatana nere, agaikerania ase omobere oye ekemanyererio giokobwatana okwo, boigo ekero Aburamu nigo atemetwe, akarorekana ere ore omoikeranu.

src: So Gad came to David and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Take your choice:
tgt: Erio Gadi akagenda ase Daudi akamoteebia, “Aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Chora erimo eri oranche.

src: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your instruction; nothing can make them stumble.
tgt: Abwo banchete amachiiko ao nigo bare n’omorembe omonene mono, kende tikeri gekobagoocha.

src: Then Absalom and all the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.
tgt: Abisalomu na abanto abwo bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagaika Yerusalemu, na Ahitofeli nigo arenge amo nere.

src: You eat the flesh of my people after stripping off their skin and breaking their bones. You chop them up like flesh for the cooking pot, like meat in a cauldron.”
tgt: Inwe nigo mokoria abanto baane. Mwabachobora risankwa, mwabuna amauga abo, mwababutorana buna chinyama chikobekwa enyongo.

src: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram's fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
tgt: Omorwoti nabwate chimeeri chiaye chia Tarisisi chiarenge goeta chinyancha amo ne chimeeri chia Hiramu. Ara rimo ase emiaka etato chimeeri chia Tarisisi nigo chiarenge gocha chiarenta chitaabu ne chifeta, na amaino e chinchogu, ne chingoge amo ne chinyoni chi'ebieni ebiya.

src: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.
tgt: Na nyuma y'amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo, bakagenda nabarabwo igoro ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka.

src: Siku sita baada ya jambo hili, Yesu akawachukua Petro, Yakobo na Yohana ndugu yake Yakobo, akawapeleka juu ya mlima mrefu peke yao.
tgt: Na nyuma y'amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo, bakagenda nabarabwo igoro ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka.

src: Those who were in the citadel kept hemming Israel in around the sanctuary, and always sought to harm them and to strengthen the Gentiles.
tgt: Ase ebiro ebio ababisa nigo barenge ase chinsinyo barenge kona kobatianera Abaisraeli ang'e nenseemo ye Hekalu. Barabwo nigo barenge kona goteema kera ekero kobaremaria Abayahudi na kobikong'ia ebisaku binde.

src: Wale waliokuwa katika ngome waliendelea kuzingira Israeli kuzunguka patakatifu, na siku zote walitaka kuwadhuru na kuwaimarisha Mataifa.
tgt: Ase ebiro ebio ababisa nigo barenge ase chinsinyo barenge kona kobatianera Abaisraeli ang'e nenseemo ye Hekalu. Barabwo nigo barenge kona goteema kera ekero kobaremaria Abayahudi na kobikong'ia ebisaku binde.

src: He engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and panels, wherever each had space, with wreaths all around.
tgt: Ase ebisiirero na ase chinsingo emegwekano y’ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba, na eye chindo, na ey’emekendo, amo ney’ebisicha, ekamang’wa, buna ribaga riarenge ase kera ensemo.

src: For each man will bear his own burden.
tgt: Naki kera omonto nebogorererie egurube yaye omonyene.

src: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
tgt: Ninki rende torateebe? Togenderere ase ebibe, erinde amaabera amenteke abe amange kobua?

src: Tuseme nini basi? Je, tuendelee kutenda dhambi ili neema ipate kuongezeka?
tgt: Ninki rende torateebe? Togenderere ase ebibe, erinde amaabera amenteke abe amange kobua?

src: For the Lord Yahweh will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won't be disappointed.
tgt: Omonene nankonye; ase ayio tinkobugwa nogochaywa; na ase ayio nakorire obosio bwane bwabeire obokong'u buna rigena, nimanyete ng'a tingosookigwa.

src: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!
tgt: Abanto ba Yuda kigita chitukia chiaino moreree abana baria mwanchete. Kora emetwe yaino erabe se buna ey'echinsoti ekiagera abana baino mbairwe obooswa are korwa ase more.

src: Nyoeni nywele zenu katika kuomboleza kwa ajili ya watoto wenu mnaowafurahia; jifanyieni upara kama tai, kwa kuwa watawaacha na kwenda uhamishoni.
tgt: Abanto ba Yuda kigita chitukia chiaino moreree abana baria mwanchete. Kora emetwe yaino erabe se buna ey'echinsoti ekiagera abana baino mbairwe obooswa are korwa ase more.

src: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
tgt: Nyasae, buna koreng’ana erieta riao rikumete, naboigo nogotogigwa kwao gokumete goikera chinsinyo chi’ense. Okoboko kwao gw’okorio nigo goichire noboronge.

src: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.'
tgt: Naende magega yaye abaiseke baria bande bagaacha, bakaboora: Omonene, toigorere!

src: “Baadaye wale wanawali wengine nao wakaja, wakaita, ‘Bwana! Bwana! Tufungulie mlango!'
tgt: Naende magega yaye abaiseke baria bande bagaacha, bakaboora: Omonene, toigorere!

src: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
tgt: Agateebia bonsi, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye kera rituko antunyane.

src: And every one of you that I do not cut off from My altar, your eyes will fail and your heart will grieve. All your descendants will die by the sword of men.
tgt: Tinkorusia kera oyomo oino korwa ase egesasiimero. Oyo ntarusie korwao nigo arabe okogoukoria amaiso, na goichania enkoro yao, na abanto bonsi b’enyomba yao nigo barakwe bataragota.

src: “Even today my complaint is bitter. His hand is heavy despite my groaning.
tgt: Nonya ngoika reero okwemurungania kwane nigo kore okororo se; ogoakwa kwane nigo kore okorito kobua okweng’ereria kwane.

src: so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
tgt: Igo okwegena kwaino, gakoratenene ase ogoteemwa, kore kwe rigori rinene kobua etaabu egosira (nonya egoteemwa ase omorero) naende konyorekane kogwenerete ogotogigwa, na obonene, na ogosikwa ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.

src: You killed the Author of life, but God raised Him from the dead, and we are witnesses of the fact.
tgt: Mogaita Omotongi bw’obogima. Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakuure, na ase ayio intwe nigo tore kirori.

src: Hivyo mkamuua aliye chanzo cha uzima, lakini Mungu akamfufua kutoka kwa wafu. Sisi tu mashahidi wa mambo haya.
tgt: Mogaita Omotongi bw’obogima. Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakuure, na ase ayio intwe nigo tore kirori.

src: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in Yahweh's house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.
tgt: Ekero Pasuri Omokuani, mosinto o Imeri, oyorenge omoteneneri omonene bw'enyomba y'Omonene, aigwete Yeremia okobana amang'ana ayio,

src: Ikawa kuhani Pashuri mwana wa Imeri, mkuu wa maafisa wa Hekalu la Bwana, alipomsikia Yeremia akitoa unabii juu ya mambo haya,
tgt: Ekero Pasuri Omokuani, mosinto o Imeri, oyorenge omoteneneri omonene bw'enyomba y'Omonene, aigwete Yeremia okobana amang'ana ayio,

src: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
tgt: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano? Nase ki otari n'obotoereru? Semeria Nyasae! Igo ninyare komotogia naende ase ogotooreka gokorwa ase obosio bwaye.

src: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers' households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.
tgt: Aba bonsi nabwo ab'ororeria rwa Yediaeli. Barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, naende nigo barenge abakong'u ase esegi. Omobaro obo nechilifu ikomi na isano na ibere, na amagana abere (17,200).

src: They were snatched away before their time, and their foundations were swept away by a flood.
tgt: Abwo nigo bataboretigwe engaki yabo konya etaraika; na oboroso bwabo bokairwa buna omogooko okoira.

src: When they had heard all these words, they turned to one another in fear and said to Baruch, “Surely we must report all these words to the king.”
tgt: Ekero baigwete amang’ana ayio, bakaonchoka bakarigererania bare nobwoba, bagateebia Baruku, “Goika toteebie omorwoti amang’ana aya.”

src: Walipoyasikia maneno hayo yote, wakatazamana wao kwa wao kwa woga na kumwambia Baruku, “Lazima tutoe taarifa ya maneno haya yote kwa mfalme.”
tgt: Ekero baigwete amang’ana ayio, bakaonchoka bakarigererania bare nobwoba, bagateebia Baruku, “Goika toteebie omorwoti amang’ana aya.”

src: Whatever house you enter, begin by saying, ‘Peace to this house.’
tgt: Na enyomba ende yonsi morasoe, ritang’ani mobore: Omorembe obe ase enyomba eye.

src: “Mkiingia katika nyumba yoyote, kwanza semeni, ‘Amani iwe kwenu.’
tgt: Na enyomba ende yonsi morasoe, ritang’ani mobore: Omorembe obe ase enyomba eye.

src: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
tgt: Daudi akaba omorisia bw'abaanto abwo ore nenkoro endonge, akaba okobaraa nokoboko kw'obong'aini.

src: Then King David went in, sat before the LORD, and said, “Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
tgt: Erio Daudi omorwoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae, akabora, Aye Omonene, inche ninki ing’isaine, na eamate yane ninki eisaine, ng’a aye gwankoreire amang’ana amaya iga?

src: until the LORD has driven men far away and the land is utterly forsaken.
tgt: Inche Omonene ning’anyie abanto abwo korwa ase ense eyio bagende aare, na aase agwo aratigwe are bosa, nabe aange mono ase ense eyio.

src: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
tgt: abeamate ya Pasuri: Elioenai na Maaseya, Isumaeli na Netaneli, Yosabadi na Elasa.

src: For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink, I was a stranger and you took Me in,
tgt: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, mokang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, mokang’a nkanywa; inarenge omogeni, mokandoisia;

src: Kwa maana nilikuwa na njaa mkanipa chakula, nilikuwa na kiu mkaninywesha, nilikuwa mgeni mkanikaribisha,
tgt: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, mokang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, mokang’a nkanywa; inarenge omogeni, mokandoisia;

src: “If you will not,” said Naaman, “please let me, your servant, be given as much soil as a pair of mules can carry. For your servant will never again make a burnt offering or a sacrifice to any other god but the LORD.
tgt: Erio Naamani agateeba: “Onye taibo, nagosabire, tiga inche omosomba oo ’ng’eegwe amaroba aisaine chigurube ibere, chibarasi ibere chiranyare kobogoria, ekiagera korwa bono na kogenderera inche omosomba oo tinkorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase enyasae ende yonsi, otatiga nase Omonene bweka.

src: The good man obtains favor from the LORD, but the LORD condemns a man who devises evil.
tgt: Omonene nigo akomonyoorera monto omuya ogwancherwa, korende omonachera ekiina oyogokora emeroberio y’obobe.

src: For through Yahweh's voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.
tgt: Ase eriogi ri'Omonene, na ase ogoaka nenyimbo yaye, Abaasuri mbaondoke mono.

src: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
tgt: ase abwo bagosira ogotioka kw'amakweri gokorenta amakweri; ase abwo bagotoorigwa ogotioka kw'obogima gokorenta obogima. Ning'o oraisane ase amang'ana aya?

src: as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,
tgt: na egetinti amo nebigogwa emechoro bi’oboseera bi’egatani engiya, ne chisirwari chi’egatani engiya,

src: Nothing was too hard for him. When he was buried, his body prophesied.
tgt: Tiriarengeo ing'ana rinde rionsi riamokong'erete ere, na ekero akwete, omobere oye okarua obobani.

src: Hakuna kilichokuwa kigumu kwake. Alipozikwa, mwili wake ulitabiri.
tgt: Tiriarengeo ing'ana rinde rionsi riamokong'erete ere, na ekero akwete, omobere oye okarua obobani.

src: After Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, as well as the officials of Judah and the craftsmen and metalsmiths from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon, the LORD showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the temple of the LORD.
tgt: Magega Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, kairire Yekonia, mosinto o Yehoyakimu, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, amo nabanene b’oborwoti boria, na abaroisia b’ebinto, na abaturi b’ebioma, gochia Babiloni, Omonene akanyorokia okorora oko: Bosio bwe Hekalu y’Omonene nkarora ebitonga bibere biarenge namako.

src: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don't hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
tgt: Akabeeka amaru inse, akarera ase eriogi rinene: “Omonene, tobabare ebibe ebi!” Ochia gokoora gokwana aya, agakwa. Na Saulo nigo aroche buya ase ogoitwa kwaye.

src: Kisha akapiga magoti, akalia kwa sauti kubwa akasema, “Bwana usiwahesabie dhambi hii.” Baada ya kusema hayo, akalala.
tgt: Akabeeka amaru inse, akarera ase eriogi rinene: “Omonene, tobabare ebibe ebi!” Ochia gokoora gokwana aya, agakwa. Na Saulo nigo aroche buya ase ogoitwa kwaye.

src: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech their brother who killed them, and on the men of Shechem who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.
tgt: Aya nigo abeete bo, erinde obobe obwo bwakoreretwe abana abamura baria ba Yerubi‐Baali emerongo etano n'ebere boakanerwe egesiomba. Ase igo okomocha kw'ogoiterwa kw'amanyinga abo kogaakanerwa igoro y'Abimeleki, oyio obaitete, naende igoro y' abanto ba Sekemu, abwo bamobegete chinguru chi'ogokora ayio.

src: Hili lilitokea ili ule ukatili waliotendewa hao wana sabini wa Yerub-Baali upatilizwe, na damu yao iwe juu ya Abimeleki ndugu yao aliyewaua, na pia iwe juu ya watu wa Shekemu, ambao walimsaidia kuua ndugu zake.
tgt: Aya nigo abeete bo, erinde obobe obwo bwakoreretwe abana abamura baria ba Yerubi‐Baali emerongo etano n'ebere boakanerwe egesiomba. Ase igo okomocha kw'ogoiterwa kw'amanyinga abo kogaakanerwa igoro y'Abimeleki, oyio obaitete, naende igoro y' abanto ba Sekemu, abwo bamobegete chinguru chi'ogokora ayio.

src: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.
tgt: Bakamosorora, bakaboora, “Kabe amo naintwe, ekiagera bwairire, na omobaso oerire bono.” Agasoa koba amo nabarabwo.

src: On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
tgt: Bakagenda bagasoa nyomba, bakarora omwana amo na Mariamu ng’ina, bagatung’ama inse, bakamosasiima. Erio bagakuunora chinibo chiabo, bakamokwaneria ebinto ebiya, etaabu, na ubani, na manemane.

src: Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them; I will return your recompense upon your heads.
tgt: Korende bono nimbarangerie barue aase aria mwabaoonetie gochia, erinde mbairanerie inwe ogokora kwaino kobe igoro yaino.

src: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.
tgt: Ekero Omonene arakore omobaro bw'abaanto, nigo ararike, “Oyo na oyo nao baiboreretwe ime aaria.”

src: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.
tgt: Amaguta ao akweakwa nigo are ne rimisu rigiya; erieta riao nigo ringa buna amaguta aumoirwe, ase ayio abakungu nigo bagwanchete.

src: and divide the land into seven portions. Judah shall remain in their territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain in their territory in the north.
tgt: Ense yatananwe ase chinsemo isano na ibere. Abayuda nigo baragenderere komenya ase orogongo rwabo agwo ensemo ya Irianyi, na Abayusufu ase orwabo, ensemo ya sugusu.

src: up to one hundred talents of silver, and to one hundred cors of wheat, and to one hundred baths of wine, and to one hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
tgt: Momoe goikera chifeta chitalanta rigana erimo (100), na engano ebitonga elifu eyemo (1,000), na edivai chilita chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600), na amaguta 'amazeituni chilita chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600), na momoe omonyoo otari na kerengo.

src: I am not making a demand, but I am testing the sincerity of your love in comparison to the earnestness of others.
tgt: Tinkwaneti aya ase okobachiika, korende ase omokia bw’abaanto bande nteeme ekeene ki’obwanchani bwaino.

src: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
tgt: Akabora, “Eke nakio gekogera nabateebia, ng'a omonto onde tari oranyare gocha ase 'nde, otatiga oeirwe na Tata one.”

src: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
tgt: Inee! Inwe nigo mokorwanerera Nyasae ase ogokwana oborimo? Naende mokomorwanerera ase obong'ainereria?

src: For God didn't give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
tgt: ekiagera omoika twaetwe na Nyasae tari oyo bw'obwoba, korende oyo bw'echinguru na obwanchani, na omoika bw'okwerenga intwe abanyene.

src: So all the officials and all the people who entered into this covenant agreed that they would free their menservants and maidservants and no longer hold them in bondage. They obeyed and released them,
tgt: Abaanene b’oborwoti amo nabaanto bonsi abakorete okobwatana ng’a kera omonto asibore omosomba oye, omosacha gose omokungu, bakaigwa amang’ana ayio na bakabasibora.

src: Kwa hiyo maafisa wote na watu walioingia katika agano hili wakakubali kwamba watawaacha huru watumwa wao wa kiume na wa kike, na hawatawashikilia tena kama watumwa. Wakakubali na wakawaacha huru.
tgt: Abaanene b’oborwoti amo nabaanto bonsi abakorete okobwatana ng’a kera omonto asibore omosomba oye, omosacha gose omokungu, bakaigwa amang’ana ayio na bakabasibora.

src: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
tgt: Naende ekero morabugie etarumbeta ase eriogi ri'ogotabobora eria'kabere, abanto bare ase ebitwori bi'enseemo ya Irianyi baimoke bachaake orogeendo. Etarumbeta goika ebugigwe ase eriogi erio ase chingaki chionsi abanto barabe bakomanora gochaaka orogeendo.

src: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”
tgt: Yeso akamororera amaabera, akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamoteebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.”

src: He said: “I will hide My face from them; I will see what will be their end. For they are a perverse generation— children of unfaithfulness.
tgt: Akabora: Nimbise obosio bwane korwa ase bare, erio ndore omoerio obo buna ogochia koba, ekiagera barabwo nekegori egesisikanu, abanto batari abeegenwa.

src: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
tgt: Anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe enyancha ime, kobua aragere oyomo bw'aba abake akore ebibe.

src: When the king would show favor to any, he would exchange many presents and give them some of this liquid.
tgt: Ase igo omorwoti akanyora chitaabu chinyinge mono korwa ase aria, echio are koa monto onde bwensi anchete.

src: Mfalme alipoonyesha upendeleo kwa yeyote, angebadilishana zawadi nyingi na kuwapa baadhi ya kinywaji hiki.
tgt: Ase igo omorwoti akanyora chitaabu chinyinge mono korwa ase aria, echio are koa monto onde bwensi anchete.

src: But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!”
tgt: Korende ekero achia korora omwaga bw’echinguru, akairoka, agachaaka korimera amaache ime, agaaka eriogi, agateeba, “Omonene ntooria!”

src: All the people of the land will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day I display My glory, declares the Lord GOD.
tgt: Abanto bonsi b’ense eyio mbagenderere kobatindeka, na ayio abe ogotogigwa kwabo. Aya nigo arakoreke ase rituko riria ndaorokie obonene bwane. Nabo Omonene ateebire.

src: Whom did He consult to enlighten Him, and who taught Him the paths of justice? Who imparted knowledge to Him and showed Him the way of understanding?
tgt: Ning’Omonene akoboria amosemie amang’ana buya? Ning’o omworokereretie oboeto bw’oboronge, na komworokia okomanya, gose komworokia enchera y’okomanya?

src: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
tgt: Abange b'abwo baraire ase riroba ime mbaboke, abande banyore obogima bwa kare na kare, na abande banyore obosooku na ogochaaywa gwa kare na kare.

src: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.
tgt: Ase ayio, tinkomocha kobainyoria amang'ana ayio botambe, nonya moyamanyete na mwabekirwe chinguru ase ekeene ekio mwanyorire.

src: But be careful that you are not enticed to turn aside to worship and bow down to other gods,
tgt: Mwerende mono chinkoro chiaino tichibang’aina. Timobaisa gotiga Omonene na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao, na gochisasiima.

src: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
tgt: Erio inche nimokore abe omwana one omotangi, abe omorwoti ore omonene kobua abarwoti bande bonsi b’ense.

src: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

src: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?
tgt: Yeso akabateebia, Timwana gosoma ase amariiko: Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona. Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?

src: Yesu akawaambia, “Je, hamjasoma katika Maandiko kwamba: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni. Bwana ndiye alitenda jambo hili, nalo ni la ajabu machoni petu’?
tgt: Yeso akabateebia, Timwana gosoma ase amariiko: Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona. Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?

src: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
tgt: Inwe abe chiamate chi'abaanto, togia Omonene! Motogie ase obonene bwaye na okobua kwaye.

src: Mpeni Bwana, enyi jamaa za mataifa, mpeni Bwana utukufu na nguvu.
tgt: Inwe abe chiamate chi'abaanto, togia Omonene! Motogie ase obonene bwaye na okobua kwaye.

src: Makerubi hao walikuwa wametandaza mabawa kuelekea juu, wakitia kivuli hicho kifuniko. Makerubi hao walielekeana, wakitazama hicho kifuniko.
tgt: Ebitongwa bibwate chimbaba abwo bakarambora chimbaaba chiabo igoro y'Oboikaranso bwa amaabera, bakabobekera ekiriri, na amasio abo agachiikana; na barabwo bakarigereria Oboikaranso bwa amaabera.

src: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother's, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.
tgt: Naboigo orakore koranyore etigere yaye, gose eanga yaye, gose gento kende gionsi ki'oyomino gesirete; aye kogokenyora tobaisa koombia tomogekoonyera.

src: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
tgt: Tiga abanto b'enyomba ya Aroni bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”

tgt: Tiga abanto b'enyomba ya Aroni bateebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”

src: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
tgt: Abanto abwo bakoirogete 'mbandore bagoke, ekiagera 'nsemeretie ring'ana riao.

src: The Jews in Susa, however, had assembled on the thirteenth and the fourteenth days of the month. So they rested on the fifteenth day, making it a day of feasting and joy.
tgt: Abayahudi abarenge Susa, barabwo nigo basangererekanete ase rituko ria ikomi na gatato, na eria ikomi na kane, na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano bagatimoka bakarikora rikaba eri’omoyega na omogooko.

src: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.
tgt: Nkabeka ebonyi ase emioro yao, na ebigera ase amato ao, na eguutwa enseera ase omotwe oo.

src: Then the priest is to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar; after that he is to have the woman drink the water.

src: Kisha kuhani atachota sadaka ya nafaka mkono uliojaa kama sehemu ya kumbukumbu na kuiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, baada ya hayo, atamtaka huyo mwanamke anywe yale maji.
