tgt: Inyora buna Akani, mosinto o Zera, amochete ase ebinto biria biatananetwe ase ogosirigwa; omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli nigo onyorete egesusuro ase engencho eyio, tari omonto oria bweka osirete ase ogosaria koria.”

src: Wakati Akani mwana wa Zera alipokosa uaminifu kwa vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu, je, ghadhabu haikulipata kusanyiko lote la Israeli? Hakuwa yeye peke yake aliyekufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake.’ ”
tgt: Inyora buna Akani, mosinto o Zera, amochete ase ebinto biria biatananetwe ase ogosirigwa; omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli nigo onyorete egesusuro ase engencho eyio, tari omonto oria bweka osirete ase ogosaria koria.”

src: When the time came for Elizabeth to have her child, she gave birth to a son.
tgt: Engaki yokoibora kwa Elisabeti egaika, ere akaibora omwana omoisia.

src: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren't able.”
tgt: ekero kiamobokire nigo gekomogaragaria inse, asokia risombogoku, na koriania amaino; ase ayio chinguru chiaye chisira. Ngakwana naborokigwa bao bageserie, tibanyara.”

src: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
tgt: Botambe nigo togoakera Nyasae ng'a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino mwensi, na kobaatora ase ogosaba gwaito.

src: Many days later the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to Perath, and get the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there.”
tgt: Magega y’amatuko amange gaetire Omonene aganteebia, “Imoka ogende goika Eufarati, orusie orokini roria nagochigeete ng’a orobise aroro, ororente aa.”

src: Baada ya siku nyingi Bwana akaniambia, “Nenda sasa Frati ukauchukue ule mkanda niliokuambia uufiche huko.”
tgt: Magega y’amatuko amange gaetire Omonene aganteebia, “Imoka ogende goika Eufarati, orusie orokini roria nagochigeete ng’a orobise aroro, ororente aa.”

src: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
tgt: Enchera y'abanyene oboronge nenteremu; naye okoyekora yaba enteremu.

src: Mapito ya wenye haki yamenyooka. Ewe uliye Mwenye Haki, waisawazisha njia ya mtu mnyofu.
tgt: Enchera y'abanyene oboronge nenteremu; naye okoyekora yaba enteremu.

src: in Ziklag; in Meconah and its villages;
tgt: abande bakamenya Sikilagi, na Mekona na ase ebichie biaye;

src: Of all the creatures that live in the water, you may eat anything with fins and scales,
tgt: “Ase echio chionsi chire ase amaache ime ’monyaare koria chinswe chibwate chingondo chinga buna chimbaaba, na amagoocho.

src: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!
tgt: Obobe nobwabo abwo bamenyete buya agwo Sayoni, na abwo batoererete ase ebitunwa bia Samaria, abwo bare abasike b'egesaku egetang'ani, eki Abaisraeli bagochiera.

src: And now He has revealed this grace through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel,
tgt: bwaorokigwe bono ase okoorokigwa kw’Omotooria oito Kristo Yeso. Ere agasiria chinguru chi’amakweri, na akarenta obogima na ogotasareka goetera ase enchiri.

src: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says Yahweh of Armies.
tgt: Korende bono tingokorera abatigari b'abaanto aba buna nakorerete ab'amatuko aria a kare. Nabo Omonene bw'Emeganda atebiire.

src: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
tgt: Bono nimenye ase Efeso goika rituko rinene ria Pentekosti;

src: Hanniel son of Ephod, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;
tgt: Korwa ase basinto ba Yusufu; ase egesaku kia Manase, Hanieli, mosinto o Efodi.

src: The king and his princes were pleased with this counsel; so the king did as Memucan had advised.
tgt: Ogosemia okwo kwa Memukani gokagokia omorwoti amo nabanene bonsi, na omorwoti agakora buna Memukani ateebete.

src: Mfalme na wakuu wake walipendezwa na shauri hili, hivyo basi mfalme akafanya kama Memukani alivyopendekeza.
tgt: Ogosemia okwo kwa Memukani gokagokia omorwoti amo nabanene bonsi, na omorwoti agakora buna Memukani ateebete.

src: ‘Cursed is the man who makes a carved idol or molten image—an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman—and sets it up in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
tgt: “Aragererigwe omonto oyoraroisie omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, koyotenenia na koyosasiima bobisi, koraabe omogwekano obaachire, gose oyo bw’ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa, eyere emeremo y’omooroisia omong’aini. Okwo n’okogeechia ase Omonene. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, bateebe: Amina.

src: “If we do go,” Saul replied, “what can we give the man? For the bread in our packs is gone, and there is no gift to take to the man of God. What do we have?”
tgt: Saulo akabooria omosomba oye: “Onye tokogenda ase omonto oyio, inki tobwate tokomoirera? Endagera twabwate ase ebibekerero biaito yaerire, na keegwa kende titobwati tokoirera omonto oyio o Nyasae. Ninki tobwate?”

src: “For who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to instruct Him?” But we have the mind of Christ.
tgt: “Naki ning’o omanyete ebirengererio bi’Omonene, erinde amworokererie?” Korende intwe ntore nebirengererio bia Kristo.

src: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
tgt: Korende inwe, abanchani, mweagache ase okwegena kwaino kore ogochenu mono, na gosaba ase Omoika Omochenu.

src: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
tgt: Omonene n'Omorwoti o kare na kare; abanto b'Ebisaku batamomanyeti basirigwe ase ense yaye.

src: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”
tgt: Nyasae tatebeti onde ase abamalaika baye: “Ikaransa ensemo y'okoboko kwane gw'okorio, goika mbabeeke ababisa bao babe inse y'amagoro ao”?

src: Is this man Coniah a despised and shattered pot, a jar that no one wants? Why are he and his descendants hurled out and cast into a land they do not know?
tgt: Inee! Omonto oyo Konia nigo abeire buna enyongo yatekire, egekorero onde ataganeti? Nase ki rende ere amo nabana baye barutirwe gochia ase ense batamanyeti?

src: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
tgt: Obotenenku bw'omonto omonda nigo bonga buna omochie omokong'u, naende nigo bonga orwaki orotambe gochia igoro rokomorenda.

src: So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.”
tgt: Ase ayio, renda kera ekero na gosaba, monyoore chinguru chi’ogoeta ase aya onsi araache koba, naende gotenena ase obosio bw’Omwana‐o‐Mwanyabaanto.”

src: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a great rumbling sound behind me: ‘Blessed be the glory of the LORD in His dwelling place!’
tgt: Erio Omoika okanyimokereria igoro, nkaigwa korwa magega y’ane eriogi buna eri’ogoaka gw’enkoba, rigoteeba: “Obonene bw’Omonene botogigwe korwa agwo ase bore!”

src: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

src: “Mungu ametukuzwa katika nguvu zake. Ni nani aliye mwalimu kama yeye?

tgt: Bono inche namanyire ng’a naye orabe omorwoti, na oborwoti bw’Abaisraeli mbogenderere koba ase okoboko kwao.

src: In the midst of kindred he who rules them has honor. Those who fear the Lord have honor in his eyes.
tgt: Gati abamura bamwabo omomura omonene nere ogwenerete gosikwa. Baria bamoirogete Nyasae mbagwenerete amasikani bosio bwaye.

src: Yeye anayewatawala ana heshima katikati ya jamaa, na wale wanaomcha Bwana wana heshima machoni pake.
tgt: Gati abamura bamwabo omomura omonene nere ogwenerete gosikwa. Baria bamoirogete Nyasae mbagwenerete amasikani bosio bwaye.

src: “But even in those days,” says Yahweh, “I will not make a full end of you.

tgt: Naende Omonene oteebire, “Nonya nase amatuko ayio tinkobasiria inwe kegima.

tgt: Nanyarekire ase okwerera kwane kw'obororo, kera obotuko nigo ngoteremia namariga ase oborere bwane, ebirarero biane biaichoirwe namariga.

src: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”
tgt: Abanto bakareo n'abanene, naende n'abatambe, abanto b'ororeeria rw'Anaki mwabeire mokoigwa chinkuma chiabo, bagokwanwa: Ning'o oranyaare kobua Abanaki?

src: You heard rebuke in Sinai, and judgments of vengeance in Horeb.
tgt: Aye kwaigwerete ogotogonya kw'Omonene aaria ase egetunwa gia Sinai, n'okoraria gw'egesusuro ase ababisa baye aaria ase egetunwa kia Orebu.

src: The fish in the Nile died, and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water. And there was blood throughout the land of Egypt.
tgt: Ne chinswe chiare ase orooche chigakwa, na orooche rokagunda na gotioka, na Abamisiri bagasinywa konywa amaache aria. Amanyinga akaba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.

src: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”

tgt: Ase ogwekeyia kwaye ekiina kiaye gekarusigwa. Ning'o oranyare gototeebia ororeria rwaye? Ekiagera obogima bwaye bwarusigwe ase ense.”

src: Furthermore, let both man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and have everyone call out earnestly to God. Let each one turn from his evil ways and from the violence in his hands.

src: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus' chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

src: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

tgt: Akaba ase erooro amatuko emerongo ene, ogoteemwa na Saitani; ere nigo arenge amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana; na abamalaika bakaba nkomokorera bare. Yeso okorangeria Abarubi bane (Mat 4:17; Luk 4:14-15)

tgt: Inwe aba’mokoriina chitigere chindabu, nainwe aba’mogoikaransa ase emegeeke yaino, nainwe aba’mogotaara ase chinchera, morarie amang’ana ayio!

src: Don't be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don't deceive with your lips.

src: The border continued to the northern slope of Beth-hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan. This was the southern border.

src: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was proclaimed among you by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not “Yes” and “No,” but in Him it has always been “Yes.”

src: No one is to enter the house of the LORD except the priests and those Levites who serve; they may enter because they are consecrated, but all the people are to obey the requirement of the LORD.

src: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?

src: Assaulting them vigorously, they took control of the positions, and kept off all who fought upon the wall, and killed those whom they encountered, killing no fewer than twenty thousand.

src: This advice pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Memucan:
tgt: Ogosemia okwo kwa Memukani gokagokia omorwoti amo nabanene bonsi, na omorwoti agakora buna Memukani ateebete.

src: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
tgt: Ekiagera Lida nigo orenge ang'e na Yopa, na aborokigwa konya baigure ng'a Petero nao are aria, bagatoma abanto babere asare komosorora na komoteebia: “Koranche, totebana gocha ase tore.”

src: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.
tgt: Ninsirie oborogi korwa ase amaboko aino, na abaringoria tibakonyorekana ase more nonya ng'ake.

src: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
tgt: Korende nigo basang'ananete n'abanto abwo bakeorokereria ogokora kwabo.

src: bali walijichanganya na mataifa na wakazikubali desturi zao.
tgt: Korende nigo basang'ananete n'abanto abwo bakeorokereria ogokora kwabo.

src: Surely He would rebuke you if you secretly showed partiality.
tgt: Ekeene ere nabatogonyere Onye mogokora ogwanchereria bobisi.

src: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”
tgt: Rora, reero gwanseririe korwa ase riroba eri, nimbiseke korwa ase obosio bwao, timborora naende. Nimbe omoomboganu na omoetanani ase ense, na onde bwensi orang'umere nigo arang'ite.”

src: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
tgt: (Ototera gw'Asafu) Aye Nyasae, nase ki gwatotigire kegima? Ninki gekogera endamwamu yao yokire igoro ye ching'ondi chi'oborisia bwao?

src: Utenzi wa Asafu. Ee Mungu, mbona umetukataa milele? Mbona hasira yako inatoka moshi juu ya kondoo wa malisho yako?
tgt: (Ototera gw'Asafu) Aye Nyasae, nase ki gwatotigire kegima? Ninki gekogera endamwamu yao yokire igoro ye ching'ondi chi'oborisia bwao?

src: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money which is brought into Yahweh's house, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people.
tgt: “Genda ase Hilikia, Omokuani bw'omonene, omoboorie abare chitaabu chiarentirwe ase enyomba y'Omonene, echio abarendi b'egesieri basangereirie korwa ase abanto.

src: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.
tgt: Erio omorwoti agatoma abanto bagachia komwoyia korwa o Makiri, mosinto bw'Amieli, aaria Lo‐Debari.

src: Then the priest is to pour some of the oil into his left palm
tgt: Omokuani ataaere amaguta ase oroe rw’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.

src: Now there was a Benjamite, a powerful man, whose name was Kish son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah of Benjamin.
tgt: Ase egesaku gia Benjamini nareengeo omonto oyomo ore korokwa Kisi, mosinto bw’Abieli, o Serori, o Bekorati bw’Afia, omonto bw’egesaku gia Benjamini. Kisi nigo areenge omonto omonda.

src: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
tgt: na ere oyobwanchete oyomwabo nigo amenyete ase omobaso, na ime asare gento tikeiyo keragere agochwe.

src: He was caught away, lest evil should change his understanding, or guile deceive his soul.
tgt: Nigo amonganyetie erio obobe tiboonchora ebirengererio biaye gose obongainereria tibosiria omoyo oye.

src: Alinyakuliwa, uovu usije ukabadilisha ufahamu wake, au hila ikamdanganya roho yake.
tgt: Nigo amonganyetie erio obobe tiboonchora ebirengererio biaye gose obongainereria tibosiria omoyo oye.

src: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
tgt: Ase okwegena akarua Misiri, tairoka endamwamu y'omorwoti, ekiagera aremereretie buna oyororire ere oyotari kororekana.

src: “As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
tgt: “Aya morooche; amatuko nache ritatigare rigena erimo igoro ase erinde eritatagorwe.” Amabe agochi‐gocha (Mat 24:3-25; Mar 13:3-23)

src: “Kuhusu haya mnayoyaona hapa, wakati utafika ambapo hakuna jiwe moja litakalobaki juu ya jingine, bali kila moja litabomolewa.” Mateso (Mathayo 24:3-14; Marko 13:3-13)
tgt: “Aya morooche; amatuko nache ritatigare rigena erimo igoro ase erinde eritatagorwe.” Amabe agochi‐gocha (Mat 24:3-25; Mar 13:3-23)

src: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.
tgt: Abanto abwo bakaimokia amasie abo konya atarabekwa memera, bakaboa ebituba biabo, ebi baare oboseemiara obosie, ase ebitambaa biabo baare kwambara, bakabibogoria ase amareko abo.

src: Let's see if his words are true. Let's test what will happen at the end of his life.
tgt: Bono intwe tiga torore gose amang'ana aye nayekeene, tiga torore ayaramonyore ekero arakwe.

src: Hebu tuone kama maneno yake ni ya kweli. Hebu tujaribu kitakachotokea mwishoni mwa maisha yake.
tgt: Bono intwe tiga torore gose amang'ana aye nayekeene, tiga torore ayaramonyore ekero arakwe.

src: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of Yahweh's covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.
tgt: Musa akariika amachiiko ayio, erio akayaa abakuani Abalawi barenge kobogoria Esanduki ere ne chibao chiriikire okobwatana kw'ogotianania kw'Omonene, boigo akayea abagaaka bonsi b'Abaisraeli.

src: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one. Do Not Love the World
tgt: Nabarikerete inwe, abana bane, ekiagera momomanyete tata. Nabarikeire inwe aba Tata ekiagera momomanyete ere oyonge oo korwa omochakano. Nabarikerete inwe, abamura, ekiagera more ne chinguru, ne ring’ana ria Nyasae ndire ime yaino, na mwabuire oria omobe.

src: Nawaandikia ninyi akina baba, kwa sababu mmemjua yeye aliye tangu mwanzo. Nawaandikia ninyi vijana, kwa sababu mna nguvu, na neno la Mungu linakaa ndani yenu, nanyi mmemshinda yule mwovu. Msiupende Ulimwengu
tgt: Nabarikerete inwe, abana bane, ekiagera momomanyete tata. Nabarikeire inwe aba Tata ekiagera momomanyete ere oyonge oo korwa omochakano. Nabarikerete inwe, abamura, ekiagera more ne chinguru, ne ring’ana ria Nyasae ndire ime yaino, na mwabuire oria omobe.

src: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.
tgt: Endo tekobao ase enchera eyio, gose eng'iti ende y'orosana tegochao, chirochio tichikonyorekana aroro, korende abanto baboorigwe nabwo barataare ase enchera eyio.

src: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:
tgt: Naki mobe nebirengererio ebio ebio ime yaino buna ebio biarenge ime ya Kristo Yeso.

src: and sent Timothy, our brother and God's servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,
tgt: Togatoma Timotheo oyominto, omokori emeremo amo na Nyasae ase okorandia enchiri ya Kristo, erinde abakong'ie na kobaremia ase okwegena kwaino,

src: then the one presenting his offering to the LORD shall also present a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter hin of olive oil.
tgt: Oyokorua ebing’wanso buna ebio ase Omonene, goika arue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke ebimunu bibere bwochoganirie n’amaguta egetuba ekemo,

src: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.
tgt: Ere agatoma abanto ase Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, agwo Petori ore ang'e norooche rw'Eufarati, ase ense yabo. Barabwo bakamoteebia amang'ana a Balaki. “Rigereria, abanto bachire korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nabarabwo nabange, batubete orogongo rwonsi, batoorire ang'e naintwe, barigereretie ense yane.

src: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son, that he may die, because he has broken down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the Asherah that was by it.”
tgt: Erio abanto b'omochie oria bagateebia Yoashi, “Morente omomura oyio oo aiga, ere goika aitwe, ekiagera otagoire egesasiimero gia Baali, na otagoire omote oria bw'Asera orenge ensemo yaye.”

src: Watu wa mji wakamwambia Yoashi, “Mlete mwanao hapa. Ni lazima afe, kwa sababu amebomoa madhabahu ya Baali na kukatakata nguzo ya Ashera iliyokuwa karibu nayo.”
tgt: Erio abanto b'omochie oria bagateebia Yoashi, “Morente omomura oyio oo aiga, ere goika aitwe, ekiagera otagoire egesasiimero gia Baali, na otagoire omote oria bw'Asera orenge ensemo yaye.”

src: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.
tgt: Okorega okwo gwakiinire, kwabeire enyimbo igoro y'abwo bagokora amabe. Omonto obo tagotigara nonya noyomo; obotenenku bwabo mbosirigwe amo na kende gionsi babwate, na obonene bwabo bwonsi mboere.

src: Then the Amorites who lived in the hills came out against you and chased you like a swarm of bees. They routed you from Seir all the way to Hormah.
tgt: Abaamori abamenyete ase ense eria bagaacha bakabaumokera buna chinchoke. Bakabaseria goika Horima erio bakababua agwo ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Edomu.

src: They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
tgt: Abanto abwo tibamanyeti gento, tibari nobong’aini, nigo bagotaara bakona‐kouna‐una ime ase omosunte; amaroso ’ense anyegerigwe.

src: “Hawajui lolote, hawaelewi lolote. Wanatembea gizani; misingi yote ya dunia imetikisika.
tgt: Abanto abwo tibamanyeti gento, tibari nobong’aini, nigo bagotaara bakona‐kouna‐una ime ase omosunte; amaroso ’ense anyegerigwe.

src: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and Yahweh will not answer you in that day.”
tgt: Ase engaki eyio inamobe mokorera nobororo ase engencho y'omorwoti oino, oyio mwechorerete, korende Omonene takoba ogotegerera okorera kwaino.”

src: Siku ile itakapowadia, mtalia kwa kutaka msaada kutokana na mfalme mliyemchagua, naye Bwana hatawajibu.”
tgt: Ase engaki eyio inamobe mokorera nobororo ase engencho y'omorwoti oino, oyio mwechorerete, korende Omonene takoba ogotegerera okorera kwaino.”

src: As a house that is destroyed, so is wisdom to a fool. The knowledge of an unwise man is talk without sense.
tgt: Ase omonto omoriri chisemi nigo chinga buna enyomba yagure; n'emeroberio y'omonto omoriri igo are amang'ana atari na moroberio.

src: Kama nyumba iliyobomolewa, ndivyo hekima ilivyo kwa mpumbavu. Maarifa ya mtu asiye na akili ni kama maneno yasiyo na maana.
tgt: Ase omonto omoriri chisemi nigo chinga buna enyomba yagure; n'emeroberio y'omonto omoriri igo are amang'ana atari na moroberio.

src: He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.
tgt: Agasaria aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, na agatagora chisiiro chigosasimerwa amo nomote bw'Asera, enyasae eria enkuungu. Akabutorana ebing'ese eng'iti y'etai eria Musa aroisetie, ekiagera goika ase amatuko aria Abaisraeli igo bagendererete koyesambera ubani; bakayeroka Nehusitani.

src: Akapaondoa mahali pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, akazivunja sanamu, akakatakata nguzo za Ashera. Akavunja vipande vipande ile nyoka ya shaba Mose aliyotengeneza, kwa kuwa hadi siku hizo wana wa Israeli walikuwa wanaifukizia uvumba (ilikuwa ikiitwa Nehushtani).
tgt: Agasaria aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, na agatagora chisiiro chigosasimerwa amo nomote bw'Asera, enyasae eria enkuungu. Akabutorana ebing'ese eng'iti y'etai eria Musa aroisetie, ekiagera goika ase amatuko aria Abaisraeli igo bagendererete koyesambera ubani; bakayeroka Nehusitani.

src: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.
tgt: Akaira Petero na abana baria ba Zebedi babere, agachaaka goichana na gwechanda mono.

src: Wake up righteously and don't sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
tgt: Boka buna egwenerete ase oboronge, timokora ebibe naende. Naki abande tibamomanyeti Nyasae. Natebiire aya ase okobasookia.

src: Zindukeni mwe na akili kama iwapasavyo, wala msitende dhambi tena; kwa maana watu wengine hawamjui Mungu. Nasema mambo haya ili mwone aibu.
tgt: Boka buna egwenerete ase oboronge, timokora ebibe naende. Naki abande tibamomanyeti Nyasae. Natebiire aya ase okobasookia.

src: “Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is tasty!”
tgt: “Amaache aibire nigo are amansu, na omogati okorierwa aase abobisi nigo ogwansa.”

src: She died in Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went out to mourn and to weep for her.
tgt: Sara agakwera ase Kiriati‐Ariba, agwo nao Heburoni, ase ense ya Kaanani. Aburaamu akagenda komoreera Sara na okweumia okonene, na akaroberia omoyega bw’ogotindekwa kwaye.

src: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.
tgt: Nkarora okoboko kogonkuna, gokanyimokia, ngatung'ama n'amaru, ngasigamera inse nebisanyi bi'amaboko nkoiguswa.

src: Hadadezer sent and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the River; and they came to Helam, with Shobach the captain of the army of Hadadezer at their head.
tgt: Hadadeseri agatoma abanto barente Abasiiria abwo barenge moocha y'orooche rw'Eufarati. Barawo bagaacha Helamu, na Sobaki, omotang'ani bw'abarwani ba Hadadeseri, akabatang'ana.

src: Hadadezeri akaagiza Waaramu walioletwa kutoka ngʼambo ya Mto Frati, wakaenda Helamu pamoja na Shobaki jemadari wa jeshi la Hadadezeri akiwaongoza.
tgt: Hadadeseri agatoma abanto barente Abasiiria abwo barenge moocha y'orooche rw'Eufarati. Barawo bagaacha Helamu, na Sobaki, omotang'ani bw'abarwani ba Hadadeseri, akabatang'ana.

src: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.
tgt: Emambia ya kabere, Yonathani amo nomwana oria omomura, bakagenda mogondo, ase engaki konya bachikanire na Daudi.

src: Haman also said, “Yes, Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and tomorrow I am also invited by her together with the king.
tgt: Naende Hamani akabora, “Esiteri eting'ana, moka omorwoti, naroisia endagera, tarangeretie onde otatiga inche bweka amo nomorwoti. Nonya ng'ankio nagatorangeretie, inche amo nomorwoti.

src: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.
tgt: Kora iga: Rusia abarwoti, kera oyomo ase emeremo yaye, na ase amabaga abo obeke abatang'ani b'abasikari.

src: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”
tgt: ekiagera arenge kworokereria aborokigwa baye, akabateebia ng'a, “Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto nkogenda are kobekwa ase amaboko y' abanto, na barabwo nabamoite, na ekero aitirwe naboke magega y'amatuko atato.”

src: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
tgt: Obogima obwo bokaorokigwa, na intwe tokaborora na kobobera kirori; na intwe igo tokabaraareria inwe obogima obwo bwa kare na kare, obwo bwarenge ase Tata na koorokigwa ase tore.

src: Uzima huo ulidhihirishwa; nasi tumeuona na kuushuhudia, nasi twawatangazia uzima wa milele, ambao ulikuwa pamoja na Baba, nao ukadhihirishwa kwetu.
tgt: Obogima obwo bokaorokigwa, na intwe tokaborora na kobobera kirori; na intwe igo tokabaraareria inwe obogima obwo bwa kare na kare, obwo bwarenge ase Tata na koorokigwa ase tore.

src: Get up and consecrate the people, saying, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Among you, O Israel, there are things devoted to destruction. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.
tgt: Bono imoka, ochene abanto! Obateebie bechene na kwebeeka ang’e goika ankio, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, natebiire iga: Inwe Abaisraeli imobwate ase egati yaino ebinto biatananetwe na koragererigwa, timokonyara kobua ababisa baino goika mwarusirie ebinto ebio korwa ase more.

src: Although they wanted to arrest Him, they were afraid of the crowds, because the people regarded Him as a prophet.
tgt: Korende ekero bachia korigia komobwata, bakairoka emeganda, ekiagera abanto konya banchire ng’a ere nomobani.

src: What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?
tgt: Inee! Mwanyabaanto ninki are goika anyare koba oyochenegete? Gose ere oyio oiboire nomokuungu ng’a anyare koba omonyaboronge?

src: You shall keep the feast of weeks to Yahweh your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how Yahweh your God blesses you.
tgt: Morende Amatuko Amanene ye Chichuma ase Omonene Nyasae oino, Morente ebiegwa bi'ogwancha ase Omonene Nyasae oino, mobirue buna koreng'ana abasesenirie.

src: A foolish son is his father’s ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like a constant dripping.
tgt: Omwana omomura omoriri nigo akorentera ise amabe, na omokungu okona‐kwomana nigo anga buna amatoima y’embura akona‐gotonya.

src: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
tgt: Obosiani bw'Omonene, Nyasae oito, bobe igoro yaito, na emeremo y'amaboko aito oyesesenie ase tore, ee, osesenie emeremo y'amaboko aito!

src: “Why are you so amazed?” said the angel. “I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
tgt: Na omomalaika oria aganteebia, “Naki ogokumia? Ningoteebie obobisi bw’omokuungu oyio, na obw’eng’iti eyio emobogoretie ere nemetwe etano na ebere, ne ching’unchara ikomi.

src: Is Israel a slave? Was he born into slavery? Why then has he become prey?
tgt: Inee! Abaisraeli nabasomba bare? Gose nigo baiboretwe bare abasomba? Onye taibo, nase ki rende abeire buna oy’ogotwarwa?

src: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;
tgt: Onye omonto oria taganeti kobooria oboremo boria, korende aboonerie omonto omoao, rirorio oboremo obwo tibokoboorigwa nonya 'ng'ake.

src: Kama pengine halikomboi shamba hilo, au kama ameliuza kwa mtu mwingine, kamwe haliwezi kukombolewa.
tgt: Onye omonto oria taganeti kobooria oboremo boria, korende aboonerie omonto omoao, rirorio oboremo obwo tibokoboorigwa nonya 'ng'ake.

src: At first His disciples did not understand these things, but after Jesus was glorified they remembered what had been done to Him, and they realized that these very things had also been written about Him.
tgt: Amang’ana aya aborokigwa baye tibayamanyete agwo ritang’ani, korende magega Yeso gatogigwe, erio bakainyora ng’a narikeire aya, naende ng’a mbamokorere aya.

src: “How many years have you lived?” Pharaoh asked.
tgt: Farao akabooria Yakobo: “Inee! Emiaka yao nerenga?”

src: Farao akamuuliza, “Je una umri gani?”
tgt: Farao akabooria Yakobo: “Inee! Emiaka yao nerenga?”

src: Sow for yourselves righteousness and reap the fruit of loving devotion; break up your unplowed ground. For it is time to seek the LORD until He comes and sends righteousness upon you like rain.
tgt: Ebusurere oboronge, mogese ayare ay’obwanchani, eremere chimbuna chiaino, ekiagera eye nero engaki y’okomorigia Omonene, erinde ache abatwerie oboronge buna embura egotwa.

src: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
tgt: Naboigo, ekiagera ebinto ebi bionsi nabisire, nebagwenerete inwe mobe abanto b'orogendo oroochenu na abe chingencho chi'obonyasae.

src: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and Yahweh spoke with Moses.
tgt: Ekero Musa asoire Eema eria, riire riare buna esiiro riba rigoika na gotenena ase egesoero ki'Eema eria, n'Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa.

src: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;
tgt: Obachiike naende bakore amaya, babe abanda ase ogokora okuya, babe ang'e korua chinibo chiabo, na gwatanera abaande ase emioyo emiya,

src: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.
tgt: Ere nigo arenge omwegenwa asare ere oyomochorete, buna Musa boigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae.

src: Alikuwa mwaminifu kwa yeye aliyemweka, kama vile Mose alivyokuwa mwaminifu katika nyumba yote ya Mungu.
tgt: Ere nigo arenge omwegenwa asare ere oyomochorete, buna Musa boigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae.

src: But if you will listen carefully to his voice and do everything I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes.
tgt: Korende koramoigwere ere, na gokora ayio onsi nakwanire inche, rirorio nindwanie ababisa bao, ninchande abwo bakogochanda.

src: You will sing as on the night of a holy festival, and your heart will rejoice like one who walks to the music of a flute, going up to the mountain of the LORD, to the Rock of Israel.
tgt: Inwe motere ogoteera buna nokw’omoyega omochenu bw’obotuko; chinkoro chiaino nchibe nomogooko buna ekero abanto bakobugia ebiroria kobagotiira gochia ase egetunwa ki’Omonene, ere oyore Egetare ki’Abaisraeli.

src: But God has revealed it to us by the Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.

src: When the king’s command and edict had been proclaimed, many young women gathered at the citadel of Susa under the care of Hegai. Esther was also taken to the palace and placed under the care of Hegai, the custodian of the women.

tgt: Oboenenu nigo bokorenta okoamererania, korende baria bakoigwera ogoseemigwa nigo bakoba n'obong'aini.

src: And the couriers traveled from city to city through the land of Ephraim and Manasseh as far as Zebulun; but the people scorned and mocked them.

src: The sinner will be overpowered through his lips. By them, the insulter and the arrogant will stumble.

src: How often is the lamp of the wicked put out? Does disaster come upon them? Does God, in His anger, apportion destruction?

src: In those days I also saw Jews who had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.

src: and if the mark in the fabric, leather, weave, knit, or leather article is green or red, then it is contaminated with mildew and must be shown to the priest.

src: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.

src: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

src: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

src: and they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned Yahweh their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, and worshiped them, and served them. Therefore Yahweh has brought all this evil on them.'”

src: Watu watajibu, ‘Kwa sababu wamemwacha Bwana Mungu wao, aliyewatoa baba zao Misri, nao wamekumbatia miungu mingine, wakaiabudu na kuitumikia, ndiyo sababu Bwana ameyaleta maafa haya yote juu yao.' ”

src: For we are in jeopardy of being charged with rioting for today’s events, and we have no justification to account for this commotion.”

src: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.

src: For thus says the LORD, who created the heavens—He is God; He formed the earth and fashioned it; He established it; He did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited: “I am the LORD, and there is no other.
tgt: Omonene oyio otongete igoro chionsi, nere Nyasae, nere otongete ense akayebeeka oboroso obokong’u. Tayetongete ng’a ebe bosa, nigo ayetongete emenywe. Aya nar’Omonene agoteeba: “Inche ninche Omonene, nyasae ende teiyo.

src: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
tgt: “Inwe abanto baane, tegerera moigwe, inche nkwane! Inwe Abaisraeli, inche nimbe nkorua oborori bore mamincha yaino. Inche Nyasae inde Nyasae oino.

src: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.'
tgt: ekiagera abatigari mbache korwa Yerusalemu, na korwa ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, ekeombe ki'abaanto baratooreke. Risemi ri'Omonene bw'Emeganda ndiikeranie amang'ana ayio.

src: Kwa kuwa kutoka Yerusalemu watakuja mabaki, na kutoka Mlima Sayuni kundi la walionusurika. Wivu wa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ndio utatimiza jambo hili.
tgt: ekiagera abatigari mbache korwa Yerusalemu, na korwa ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, ekeombe ki'abaanto baratooreke. Risemi ri'Omonene bw'Emeganda ndiikeranie amang'ana ayio.

src: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.
tgt: Mobogorie chitaabu ara kabere ase amaboko aino, moirane chitaabu chiria chiairanetigwe, echio chiabegetwe igoro y'endagera ase chigunia chiaino ime. Aande nigo chiebetwe chikabekwao.

src: Chukueni fedha mara mbili, kwa kuwa mtazirudisha zile fedha zilizowekwa midomoni mwa magunia yenu. Labda ziliwekwa kwa makosa.
tgt: Mobogorie chitaabu ara kabere ase amaboko aino, moirane chitaabu chiria chiairanetigwe, echio chiabegetwe igoro y'endagera ase chigunia chiaino ime. Aande nigo chiebetwe chikabekwao.

src: When Adam was 130 years old, he had a son in his own likeness, after his own image; and he named him Seth.
tgt: Ekero Adamu konya amenyire emiaka rigana erimo na emerongo etato (130), akaba ise bw’omwana omomura omobwekaine, ore ekieni kiaye ere omonyene, akamoroka Seti.

src: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
tgt: Morwani onde tari, oyokogeenda ase esegi, orebeke ase amang'ana ande onsi y'ense eye, erinde amogwenere ere oyomoriigete.

src: So the king prepared a great feast for them, and after they had finished eating and drinking, he sent them away, and they returned to their master. And the Aramean raiders did not come into the land of Israel again. The Siege and Famine of Samaria
tgt: Ase igo omorwoti akabaroiseria omoyega omonene, na ekero bakoorire koria na konywa, akabaa ribaga, na barabwo bakagenda ase omonene obo. Abasiiria baria tibairanete naende nebiombe biabo korwania Abaisraeli. Okonaarigwa gwa Samaria

src: Basi akawaandalia karamu kubwa, na baada ya kula na kunywa, akawaaga nao wakarudi kwa bwana wao. Hivyo, vikosi kutoka Aramu vikakoma kuvamia nchi ya Israeli. Njaa Katika Samaria Iliyozingirwa
tgt: Ase igo omorwoti akabaroiseria omoyega omonene, na ekero bakoorire koria na konywa, akabaa ribaga, na barabwo bakagenda ase omonene obo. Abasiiria baria tibairanete naende nebiombe biabo korwania Abaisraeli. Okonaarigwa gwa Samaria

src: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to remove from this place, before your very eyes and in your days, the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom.
tgt: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Ase engaki yaino ekero morigereretie ninsirie eriogi ri’omogooko, na erie chigosori, na eri’omonywomi, na eri’omoriakari.

src: Kwa kuwa hili ndilo asemalo Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, aliye Mungu wa Israeli: ‘Mbele ya macho yako na katika siku zako, nitakomesha sauti zote za shangwe na za furaha, na pia sauti za bibi arusi na bwana arusi mahali hapa.’
tgt: Aya nar’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteeba: Ase engaki yaino ekero morigereretie ninsirie eriogi ri’omogooko, na erie chigosori, na eri’omonywomi, na eri’omoriakari.

src: and she put it in her bag of food. They both went out together to prayer, according to their custom. They passed through the camp, circled around that valley, and went up to the mountain of Bethulia, and came to its gates.
tgt: Omoiseke oria akayobeeka ime ye egunia yendagera. Erio Yuditi na omoiseke oria bagasoka, buna yarenge engencho yaabo kogenda gosaba. Bagaetera ase enchera yegetwori kia Abaashuru, bagaeta ime yerikura na koriina egetunwa goika ang'e negesieri kiegesieri kiomochie o Bethulia.

src: Akaiweka kwenye mfuko wake wa chakula. Wote wawili walitoka pamoja kusali, kama ilivyokuwa desturi yao. Walipita kambini, wakazunguka bonde hilo, wakapanda mlima wa Bethulia, wakafika kwenye malango yake.
tgt: Omoiseke oria akayobeeka ime ye egunia yendagera. Erio Yuditi na omoiseke oria bagasoka, buna yarenge engencho yaabo kogenda gosaba. Bagaetera ase enchera yegetwori kia Abaashuru, bagaeta ime yerikura na koriina egetunwa goika ang'e negesieri kiegesieri kiomochie o Bethulia.

src: Blessed are you in the firmament of heaven, to be praised and glorified forever!
tgt: Mosesenie Nyasae Omonene inwe ebitongwa bi'Omonene: motogie na komoa obonene bwao kare na kare.

src: Umebarikiwa katika anga la mbinguni, upate kusifiwa na kutukuzwa milele!
tgt: Mosesenie Nyasae Omonene inwe ebitongwa bi'Omonene: motogie na komoa obonene bwao kare na kare.

src: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to Yahweh the yearly sacrifice and his vow.
tgt: Elikana amo na'baanto b'enka yaye bakagenda naende koruera Omonene ekeng'wanso gia kera omwaka na goikerania eira bariete.

src: But what do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first one and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’
tgt: “Inaki morooche? Omonto gete narenge nabana babere abamura. Akamochiera oria bw’eritang’ani, akamoteebia: Omwana one, genda reero okore emeremo ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.

src: “Lakini mwaonaje? Mtu mmoja alikuwa na wana wawili. Akamwendea yule wa kwanza akamwambia, ‘Mwanangu, nenda ukafanye kazi kwenye shamba la mizabibu leo.’
tgt: “Inaki morooche? Omonto gete narenge nabana babere abamura. Akamochiera oria bw’eritang’ani, akamoteebia: Omwana one, genda reero okore emeremo ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.

src: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
tgt: Nanyorire Daudi, omosomba one, namoakire amaguta aane amaachenu ase okomwatanana ase ’nde.

src: Then he went down, and lifted up his hands over the whole congregation of the children of Israel, to give blessing to the Lord with his lips, and to glory in his name.
tgt: Sioni akarua aroro, akaimokereria amaboko aye igoro ase omosangererekano bwonsi bwa Abaisraeli, erio koraria ogosesenigwa kw'Omonene korwa ase omonwa oye omonyene, na korimokereria erieta riaye igoro.

src: Kisha akashuka, akainua mikono yake juu ya mkutano wote wa wana wa Israeli, kumshukuru Bwana kwa midomo yake, na kulitukuza jina lake.
tgt: Sioni akarua aroro, akaimokereria amaboko aye igoro ase omosangererekano bwonsi bwa Abaisraeli, erio koraria ogosesenigwa kw'Omonene korwa ase omonwa oye omonyene, na korimokereria erieta riaye igoro.

src: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
tgt: Ase igo Esau, oyokorokwa naende Edomu, akaba okomenya ase ense y'ebitunwa bia Edomu.

src: Still having breath within him, and being inflamed with anger, he rose up, and though his blood gushed out in streams and his wounds were grievous, he ran through the crowds, and standing upon a steep rock,
tgt: Ekero konya atarakwa are n'obororo, Razi akaimoka ore n'amanyinga ayio arenge goiteka korwa ase aria ebetete omoro, akaminyoka gati gati y'abanto akariina egetare ekenene igoro agatenena.

src: Akiwa bado ana pumzi ndani yake, na akiwa amewaka hasira, aliinuka, na ingawa damu yake ilimwagika kwenye vijito na majeraha yake yalikuwa mabaya, alikimbia katikati ya umati wa watu, na kusimama juu ya mwamba mkali,
tgt: Ekero konya atarakwa are n'obororo, Razi akaimoka ore n'amanyinga ayio arenge goiteka korwa ase aria ebetete omoro, akaminyoka gati gati y'abanto akariina egetare ekenene igoro agatenena.

src: From there they moved on and camped on the other side of the Arnon, in the wilderness that extends into the Amorite territory. Now the Arnon is the border between the Moabites and the Amorites.
tgt: Magega y’ayio bakaimoka korwa Seredi, bakageenda bagatoora sugusu y’orooche rw’Arinoni, ase erooro eria eigete orobebe rw’Abaamori. Arinoni nigo rware orobebe gati y’Abamoabu na Abaamori.

src: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, Yahweh your God has not allowed you so to do.
tgt: Naende Musa agateeba, “Abanto b'ebisaku ebio mogochia goseeria nigo bakoigwera abarogi na abariori, korende inwe Omonene Nyasae oino, obakaanirie ng'a timobaisa gokora ebinto ebio.

src: Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.
tgt: Ase igo, ase ebinto bibere bitanyare koonchorwa, ime ase ebio Nyasae takonyara gokwana oborimo, intwe, abatwatameire obotamero, tonyore okoremigwa ogokong’u kobwata ogosemeria koria kwabekirwe bosio bwaito.

src: Mungu alifanya hivyo ili kwa vitu viwili visivyobadilika, yaani ahadi yake na kiapo chake, ambavyo kwavyo Mungu hawezi kusema uongo, sisi ambao tumemkimbilia ili tulishike lile tumaini lililowekwa mbele yetu tuwe na faraja thabiti.
tgt: Ase igo, ase ebinto bibere bitanyare koonchorwa, ime ase ebio Nyasae takonyara gokwana oborimo, intwe, abatwatameire obotamero, tonyore okoremigwa ogokong’u kobwata ogosemeria koria kwabekirwe bosio bwaito.

src: Geber son of Uri in the land of Gilead, including the territories of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan. There was also one governor in the land of Judah. Solomon’s Prosperity
tgt: Geberi, mosinto bwa Uri, agatenenera ense ya Gileadi yareenge kogamberwa na Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, na Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. Nigo areenge omoteneneri oyomo bweka ase ense eyio yonsi. Obogaambi bwa Sulemani bogosesenigwa

src: Geberi mwana wa Uri: katika Gileadi (nchi ya Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori na nchi ya Ogu mfalme wa Bashani). Naye alikuwa ndiye mtawala pekee katika eneo hilo. Mahitaji Ya Solomoni Ya Kila Siku
tgt: Geberi, mosinto bwa Uri, agatenenera ense ya Gileadi yareenge kogamberwa na Sihoni, omorwoti bw’Abaamori, na Ogi, omorwoti o Basani. Nigo areenge omoteneneri oyomo bweka ase ense eyio yonsi. Obogaambi bwa Sulemani bogosesenigwa

src: As you don't know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don't know the work of God who does all.
tgt: Buna otamanyeti ase embeo ekogusa gochia, gose buna amauga 'omwana ore ase enda ya ng'ina agokina, naboigo tokonyara komanya emeremo ya Nyasae oyio ogokora amang'ana onsi.

src: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
tgt: Goka na gochenga, ekiagera eng'eria yaino n'enene igoro. Inaki naboigo bachaandete ababani abarengeo ritang'ani konya motarabao.

src: Furahini na kushangilia kwa maana thawabu yenu ni kubwa mbinguni, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo walivyowatesa manabii waliokuwa kabla yenu.
tgt: Goka na gochenga, ekiagera eng'eria yaino n'enene igoro. Inaki naboigo bachaandete ababani abarengeo ritang'ani konya motarabao.

src: In a little more than a year you will tremble, O secure ones. For the grape harvest will fail and the fruit harvest will not arrive.
tgt: Inwe abakungu motechandereti kende, ekero amatuko aetanetie omwaka aerire mobe mogochandeka, ekiagera emesabibu tekwama, ne rigesa rie chindagera tirikoba.

src: They said to them, “May Yahweh look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”
tgt: bakabateebia, “Omonene abarigererie na konacha ekiina, ekiagera mwatokorire koba chindoso ase obosio bwa Farao na ase abasomba baye. Mwabaeire engencho yogotoita.”

src: wakawaambia Mose na Aroni, “Bwana na awaangalie awahukumu ninyi! Mmetufanya tunuke kwa Farao na maafisa wake, nanyi mmeweka upanga mikononi mwao ili kutuua sisi.”
tgt: bakabateebia, “Omonene abarigererie na konacha ekiina, ekiagera mwatokorire koba chindoso ase obosio bwa Farao na ase abasomba baye. Mwabaeire engencho yogotoita.”

src: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because you poured out your wealth and exposed your nakedness in your promiscuity with your lovers and with all your detestable idols, and because of the blood of your children which you gave to them,
tgt: “Aya naro Omonene agoteeba: Obosooku bwao bwaorokigwe isiko, na obogetirianda bwao tibotubiri ekero ogokora obonyaka nabanchi bao. Naende nigo gwasasimete emegwekano yao y’okogechia na okarua abana bao bakaba ekeng’wanso ase emegwekano eyio.

src: Josiah, however, did not turn away from him; instead, in order to engage him in battle, he disguised himself. He did not listen to Neco’s words from the mouth of God, but went to fight him on the Plain of Megiddo.
tgt: Korende Yosia tanchete koonchoka korwa ase Neko. Agekona ase ogwetuba ng’a tamanyekana, akagenda korwana na Neko agwo ase ense omweya ya Megido, taigwete amang’ana aye ayaruete ase Nyasae.

src: You are indeed our glory and our joy.
tgt: Ee, inwe nobonene bwaito, na omogooko oito.

src: After that, the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
tgt: Magega y’ayio abanto bakaimoka kogeenda korwa ase Haseroti, bagaika ase erooro ya Parani, bagatoora aroro.

src: “I will make mere lads their leaders, and children will rule over them.”
tgt: Omonene nabeeke abasae babe abanene babo, na abana abake baabagambere.

src: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that the city will be built to Yahweh from the tower of Hananel to the gate of the corner.
tgt: Omonene nigo agoteeba iga: “Amatuko ngocha are ekero omochie oria oraagachwe naende ase 'nde, gochakera ase Omorobiri o Hananeli goikera ase Egeita gi'Ekoona.

src: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
tgt: Oyo o gatano, Samuti bw'ororeria rwa Isihari akaba omoteneneri bw'ekeombe ki'omotienyi o gatano. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabaanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).

src: Catch for us the foxes— the little foxes that ruin the vineyards— for our vineyards are in bloom. The Bride
tgt: Tobwatere ebibwe, ebibwe biria ebike, ebio bigosaria emegondo y’emesabibu, korwa ekero emesabibu yaito yasichete. (Omoriakari)

src: Tukamatie mbweha, mbweha wale wadogo wanaoharibu mashamba ya mizabibu, mashamba yetu ya mizabibu yaliyochanua. Mpendwa
tgt: Tobwatere ebibwe, ebibwe biria ebike, ebio bigosaria emegondo y’emesabibu, korwa ekero emesabibu yaito yasichete. (Omoriakari)

src: Solomon made 70,000 of them porters, 80,000 stonecutters in the mountains, and 3,600 supervisors.
tgt: Akabeka abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) bakaba bakobogoria chigurube, ne chilifu emerongo etano na etato (80,000) bakaba bakobaacha amagena ase ebitunwa, ne chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600) bakaba bagotebereria abanto bakore emeremo.

src: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
tgt: Omonene nigo aimokererete igoro, ekiagera nigo amenyete igoro mono; naichorie Sayoni nekeene na oboronge.

src: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
tgt: Intoorie n’okoboko kwao gw’okorio na oigwe aya ’nkogosaba.

src: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law before God.
tgt: Erio Jethiro ise biara Musa akamoruera Nyasae ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa na ebing'wanso binde bi'okonyenywa. Aroni amo nabagaaka bonsi b'Abaisraeli bagacha bakaragera amo nere, ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

src: Kisha Yethro, baba mkwe wa Mose, akaleta sadaka ya kuteketezwa na dhabihu nyingine kwa Mungu, naye Aroni pamoja na wazee wote wa Israeli wakaja kula chakula pamoja na baba mkwe wa Mose mbele za Mungu.
tgt: Erio Jethiro ise biara Musa akamoruera Nyasae ekeng'wanso ki'ogosambwa na ebing'wanso binde bi'okonyenywa. Aroni amo nabagaaka bonsi b'Abaisraeli bagacha bakaragera amo nere, ase obosio bwa Nyasae.

src: But when our time there had ended, we set out on our journey. All the disciples, with their wives and children, accompanied us out of the city and knelt down on the beach to pray with us.
tgt: Ekero amatuko aito achia koera, tokaimoka, tokagenda ase orogendo rwaito; na abwo bonsi, na abakungu babo, na abana, bagatokooba goika isiko y’omochie; togatung’ama ase engegu y’enyancha, togasaba.

src: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.
tgt: Na bono amamocho aino abatangire timonyora ebinto ebio, na ebibe biaino biatangire ebinto ebiya mwarenge gocha koegwa.

src: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife. It is your father's nakedness.
tgt: Tobaisa koraara na nyoko moke, moga iso. Okwo nokomorentera iso obosooku.

src: with the choice gifts of the land and everything in it, and with the favor of Him who dwelt in the burning bush. May these rest on the head of Joseph and crown the brow of the prince of his brothers.
tgt: Abae ebinto ebiya korwa ase riroba, na ebiichire ime yaye, amo n’ogwancherwa gokorwa ase are ere oyobweorokereretie ase egetutu keria. Ogosesenigwa okwo kobe igoro y’Abayusufu, ekiagera Yusufu nigo achooretwe akaba omogambi ase egati y’abaamwabo.

src: And the ten horns are ten kings who will rise from this kingdom. After them another king, different from the earlier ones, will rise and subdue three kings.
tgt: Ching’unchara chiria ikomi, abwo nabarwoti ikomi baraoroke, na magega yabo omorwoti onde naoroke. Ere nigo arabe nogwatananekana korwa ase abwo bamotang’anerete, nabue abarwoti batato.

src: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
tgt: Inche ninche bweka ngotinyia ogosaria kwao, ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na tinkoinyora ebibe biao.

src: He said to him, “Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so.”
tgt: Yonathani akamoiraneria, “Taibo, togokwa. Tata tari gokora gento kende gionsi, ekenene gose egeke, atantebeti. Nase ki tata arambise ring'ana erio, tamanyia? Ayio takoba bo.”

src: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
tgt: Ere oyogokwana ase okobua kwaye omonyene nigo akorigia obonene bwaye omonyene; korende ere oyokorigia obonene bw'oria omotomete, nigo are oyo bw'ekeene, na asare obong'ainereria tiboiyo.

src: For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
tgt: Aye gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase amakweri, ee, gwatangire amagoro aane tagwa, erinde inyare gotaara ase obosio bwao, aye Nyasae, ase oborabu bw’abwo bare moyo.

src: Kwa kuwa umeniokoa toka kwenye mauti na miguu yangu kwenye kujikwaa, ili niweze kuenenda mbele za Mungu katika nuru ya uzima.
tgt: Aye gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase amakweri, ee, gwatangire amagoro aane tagwa, erinde inyare gotaara ase obosio bwao, aye Nyasae, ase oborabu bw’abwo bare moyo.

src: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.’”
tgt: Erio abakuani abanene na Abayahudi bagateebia Pilato, “Torika ng’a, n’Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi, korende ng’a nigo arenge kobora: Inche nomorwoti bw’Abayahudi.”

src: Viongozi wa makuhani wa Wayahudi wakapinga, wakamwambia Pilato, “Usiandike ‘Mfalme wa Wayahudi,’ bali andika kwamba mtu huyu alisema yeye ni mfalme wa Wayahudi.”
tgt: Erio abakuani abanene na Abayahudi bagateebia Pilato, “Torika ng’a, n’Omorwoti bw’Abayahudi, korende ng’a nigo arenge kobora: Inche nomorwoti bw’Abayahudi.”

src: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.'”
tgt: ekiagera bakorire ayare amabe ase obosio bwane, na botambe nigo kongechiagwa nabeire nendamwamu, korwa ase amatuko aria chisokoro chiabo chiarwete Misiri goika reero iga.”

src: Is the soil fertile or unproductive? Are there trees in it or not? Be courageous, and bring back some of the fruit of the land.” (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)
tgt: Morigererie gose riroba ndire nobotobu gose neritaka, naende gose emete nereo, gose teiyo. Mobe abaremu, morentane okwama kw’amatunda gw’ense eria.” (Engaki eria nigo yarenge ekero emesabibu konya yamire ase ogotongorwa.)

src: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
tgt: Adina ase eamate ya Harimu, na Helikai ase eamate ya Merayoti;

src: wa jamaa ya Harimu, Adna; wa jamaa ya Meremothi, Helkai;
tgt: Adina ase eamate ya Harimu, na Helikai ase eamate ya Merayoti;

src: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.
tgt: Naki ase Kristo Yeso okwaroka tikogokonyorera kende, gose ogotaroka, korende okwegena okwo nakwo kogokora emeremo ase obwanchani.

src: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

src: So I came out to meet you; I sought you, and I have found you.

src: In that day, says Yahweh, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.

src: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”

src: But as for us, the LORD is our God. We have not forsaken Him; the priests who minister to the LORD are sons of Aaron, and the Levites attend to their duties.

src: Surely I am the most ignorant of men, and I lack the understanding of a man.

src: Nanyi wakati wa asubuhi mnasema, ‘Leo kutakuwa na dhoruba, kwa sababu anga ni nyekundu na mawingu yametanda.’ Mnajua jinsi ya kupambanua kule kuonekana kwa anga, lakini hamwezi kupambanua dalili za nyakati.
tgt: Na mambia mwaboora: Reero netwe ey’omwaga, ekiagera igoro yababariirire na gosung’unana. Inwe imomanyete korora obosio bwa igoro, korende timomanyeti ebimanyererio bi’ebiro.

src: Then even the most valiant soldier with the heart of a lion will melt with fear, because all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man who has valiant men with him.
tgt: Igo nonya noyore omoremu buna endo, nigo arairianyeke kegima, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi ’mbamanyete ng’a iso nigo are etuoni y’eseegi, na abanto baye nabatindi ase esegi.

src: Basi hata yule askari hodari kuliko wengine wote, ambaye moyo wake ni kama wa simba, atayeyuka kwa hofu, kwa maana Israeli yote wanajua kwamba baba yako ni mpiganaji na kwamba wale walio pamoja naye ni watu hodari.
tgt: Igo nonya noyore omoremu buna endo, nigo arairianyeke kegima, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi ’mbamanyete ng’a iso nigo are etuoni y’eseegi, na abanto baye nabatindi ase esegi.

src: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
tgt: Akarora oyomo obo ogokorerwa bobe n'Omomisiri, akamokonya; agaakanera oria orenge gochandwa egesiomba, agaaka Omomisiri oria akamoita.

src: Samuel listened to all the words of the people and repeated them in the hearing of the LORD.
tgt: Ekero Samweli aigwete amang’ana aya Abanto bakwanire, akayaira ase Omonene.

src: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
tgt: Nimbeke enyancha inse y'okoboko kwaye, ne chindooche nchibe inse y'okoboko kwaye gw'okorio.

src: Helez the Paltite, Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
tgt: Helesi korwa Peleti, na Ira, mosinto o Ikesi, korwa Tekoa;

src: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”
tgt: Erio akabooria Yehosafati: “Nogende amo nainche, torwanie Ramoti o Gileadi?” Yehosafati akamoiraneria: “Ee, ningende amo naye, na abanto baane amo nabaanto bao, ne chibarasi chiane amo ne chibarasi chiao.”

src: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,
tgt: Ekero Zedekia omorwoti, mosinto o Yosia, achagete kogambera Abayuda, ring'ana rigacha ase 'nde inche Yeremia korwa ase Omonene

src: For as yet they didn't know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
tgt: Naki konya tibaramanya ririiko, ng'a nemogwenerete koboka korwa ase abakuure.

src: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.
tgt: Enyomba eyio nigo yareenge nebibao bire ase chindwaro isato, kera ekebao kerigereretie ekende.

src: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”
tgt: Omonene agoakane ase aya gwakorire; ee, Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, oyo gwatameire, erinde orendwe inse ye chimbaaba chiaye.”

src: Bwana na akulipe kwa yale uliyoyatenda. Ubarikiwe kwa wingi na Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, ambaye umekimbilia mabawani mwake.”
tgt: Omonene agoakane ase aya gwakorire; ee, Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, oyo gwatameire, erinde orendwe inse ye chimbaaba chiaye.”

src: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
tgt: Omonene ong'akanire, ekiagera 'ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera arooche ng'a nomochenu inde.

src: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
tgt: korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Seturi, mosinto o Mikaeli;

src: kutoka kabila la Asheri, Sethuri mwana wa Mikaeli;
tgt: korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Seturi, mosinto o Mikaeli;
